chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Wiping over the head is done on its front part."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَسْحُ اَلرَّأْسِ عَلَى مُقَدَّمِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Wiping over the head is done on its front part."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 65
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 52

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: It was narrated from Commander of the Faithful (a.s) and Ibn Abbas (may Allah (swt) be pleased with him) from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) that: "Prophet (saws) performed ablution and wiped over his feet and his sandals."
arabicText: مَا رُوِيَ عَنْ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ اِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: أَنَّهُ تَوَضَّأَ وَ مَسَحَ عَلَى قَدَمَيْهِ وَ نَعْلَيْهِ.
thaqalaynMatn: It was narrated from Commander of the Faithful (a.s) and Ibn Abbas (may Allah (swt) be pleased with him) from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) that: "Prophet (saws) performed ablution and wiped over his feet and his sandals."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 66
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: It was also narrated from Ibn Abbas that: "He described the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family), and he (Prophet (saws)) wiped over his feet."
arabicText: وَ رَوَوْا أَيْضاً عَنِ اِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: أَنَّهُ وَصَفَ وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَمَسَحَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ.
thaqalaynMatn: It was also narrated from Ibn Abbas that: "He described the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family), and he (Prophet (saws)) wiped over his feet."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 66
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 52

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: It was also narrated from him (Ibn Abbas) that he said: "Indeed, wiping is in the Book of Allah (swt), but the people insist on washing."
arabicText: وَ رُوِيَ عَنْهُ أَيْضاً أَنَّهُ قَالَ: إِنَّ فِي كِتَابِ اَللَّهِ اَلْمَسْحَ وَ يَأْبَى اَلنَّاسُ إِلاَّ اَلْغَسْلَ.
thaqalaynMatn: It was also narrated from him (Ibn Abbas) that he said: "Indeed, wiping is in the Book of Allah (swt), but the people insist on washing."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 66
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: A similar statement was also narrated from Commander of the Faithful (a.s), who said: "The Quran was revealed only with (instructions of) wiping."
arabicText: وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ مِثْلُ هَذَا عَنْ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« مَا أُنْزِلَ اَلْقُرْآنُ إِلاَّ بِالْمَسْحِ».
thaqalaynMatn: A similar statement was also narrated from Commander of the Faithful (a.s), who said: "The Quran was revealed only with (instructions of) wiping."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 66
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: It was also narrated from Ibn Abbas that he said (regarding ablution): "Two washings and two wipings."
arabicText: وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ اِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَيْضاً أَنَّهُ قَالَ: غَسْلَتَانِ وَ مَسْحَتَانِ..
thaqalaynMatn: It was also narrated from Ibn Abbas that he said (regarding ablution): "Two washings and two wipings."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 66
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me, saying: Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Al-Hasan informed me from his father, from Al-Husayn bin Al-Hasan bin Aban, and Muhammad bin Yahya from Ahmad bin Muhammad, all from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Hammad bin ‘Uthman, from Salim and Ghalib bin Hudhayl, who said:
I asked Abu Ja‘far (a.s) about wiping over the feet. Imam (a.s) said: 'It is what Jibra’il (a.s) brought down (as revelation).'"
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَالِمٍ وَ غَالِبِ بْنِ هُذَيْلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَسْحِ عَلَى اَلرِّجْلَيْنِ فَقَالَ« هُوَ اَلَّذِي نَزَلَ بِهِ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me, saying: Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Al-Hasan informed me from his father, from Al-Husayn bin Al-Hasan bin Aban, and Muhammad bin Yahya from Ahmad bin Muhammad, all from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Hammad bin ‘Uthman, from Salim and Ghalib bin Hudhayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja‘far (a.s) about wiping over the feet. Imam (a.s) said: 'It is what Jibra’il (a.s) brought down (as revelation).'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 66
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of narrators, from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about wiping over the feet, and Imam (a.s) said: 'There is no harm.'"
arabicText: وَبِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَسْحِ عَلَى اَلرِّجْلَيْنِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of narrators, from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about wiping over the feet, and Imam (a.s) said: 'There is no harm.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 67
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of narrators, from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, who said:
(Narrator said) “I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s) about wiping over the feet. How is it done?” Imam (a.s) placed his palm on the toes and then wiped it to the ankles. I asked Imam (a.s): "What if a person wiped with two fingers from his toes to his ankles like this?" Imam (a.s) said: "No, it must be with the entire palm."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَسْحِ عَلَى اَلْقَدَمَيْنِ كَيْفَ هُوَ فَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ عَلَى اَلْأَصَابِعِ ثُمَّ مَسَحَهَا إِلَى اَلْكَعْبَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ بِإِصْبَعَيْنِ مِنْ أَصَابِعِهِ هَكَذَا إِلَى اَلْكَعْبَيْنِ قَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ بِكَفِّهِ كُلِّهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of narrators, from Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Narrator said) “I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s) about wiping over the feet. How is it done?” Imam (a.s) placed his palm on the toes and then wiped it to the ankles. I asked Imam (a.s): "What if a person wiped with two fingers from his toes to his ankles like this?" Imam (a.s) said: "No, it must be with the entire palm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 67
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 52

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from his father, from Sa‘d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Ayyub bin Nuh, who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), asking him about wiping over the feet. Imam (a.s) said: 'Ablution is with wiping, and nothing else is required in it. However, if someone washes [the feet], there is no harm.'"
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَسْحِ عَلَى اَلْقَدَمَيْنِ فَقَالَ« اَلْوُضُوءُ بِالْمَسْحِ وَ لاَ يَجِبُ فِيهِ إِلاَّ ذَلِكَ وَ مَنْ غَسَلَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from his father, from Sa‘d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Ayyub bin Nuh, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), asking him about wiping over the feet. Imam (a.s) said: 'Ablution is with wiping, and nothing else is required in it. However, if someone washes [the feet], there is no harm.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 67
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 52

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me, saying: Ahmad bin Muhammad informed me, from his father, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Muhammad bin Ali bin Mahbub, from Ahmad bin Ali, from Abu Hammam, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "In ablution, the obligation in the Book of Allah (swt), the Exalted, is wiping, while washing in ablution is for the purpose of cleanliness."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« فِي اَلْوُضُوءِ اَلْفَرِيضَةُ فِي كِتَابِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى اَلْمَسْحُ وَ اَلْغَسْلُ فِي اَلْوُضُوءِ لِلتَّنْظِيفِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me, saying: Ahmad bin Muhammad informed me, from his father, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Muhammad bin Ali bin Mahbub, from Ahmad bin Ali, from Abu Hammam, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "In ablution, the obligation in the Book of Allah (swt), the Exalted, is wiping, while washing in ablution is for the purpose of cleanliness."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 67
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 53

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the first chain of narrators, from Sa‘d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Al-Hajjaj, from Tha‘labah bin Maymun, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja‘far (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "(Imam) Ali (a.s) wiped over his sandals without inserting his fingers under the straps."
arabicText: وَ بِالْإِسْنَادِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَجَّالِ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَسَحَ عَلَى اَلنَّعْلَيْنِ وَ لَمْ يَسْتَبْطِنِ اَلشِّرَاكَيْنِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the first chain of narrators, from Sa‘d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Al-Hajjaj, from Tha‘labah bin Maymun, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja‘far (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "(Imam) Ali (a.s) wiped over his sandals without inserting his fingers under the straps."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 67
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me, saying: Abu Al-Qasim Ja‘far bin Muhammad informed me, from Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Ahmad bin Idris, from Muhammad bin Ahmad, from Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Yunus, who said:
(Narrator said) "I was informed by someone who saw Abu Al-Hasan (a.s) in Mina wiping the tops of his feet, from the top of the foot to the ankle, and from the ankle back to the top of the foot."
arabicText: وَأَخْبَرَنِي الشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ رَأَى أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِمِنًى يَمْسَحُ ظَهْرَ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنْ أَعْلَى الْقَدَمِ إِلَى الْكَعْبِ وَمِنَ الْكَعْبِ إِلَى أَعْلَى الْقَدَمِ
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, narrated to me, saying: Abu Al-Qasim Ja‘far bin Muhammad informed me, from Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Ahmad bin Idris, from Muhammad bin Ahmad, from Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Yunus, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Narrator said) "I was informed by someone who saw Abu Al-Hasan (a.s) in Mina wiping the tops of his feet, from the top of the foot to the ankle, and from the ankle back to the top of the foot."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 68
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of narrators, from Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hakam bin Miskin, from Muhammad bin Marwan, who said:
Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "A man may live for sixty or seventy years, yet Allah (swt) does not accept a single prayer from him." I asked: "How is that?" Imam (a.s) replied: "Because he washes what Allah (swt) has commanded to be wiped."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنِ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِنَّهُ يَأْتِي عَلَى اَلرَّجُلِ سِتُّونَ وَ سَبْعُونَ سَنَةً مَا قَبِلَ اَللَّهُ مِنْهُ صَلاَةً» قُلْتُ وَ كَيْفَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ« لِأَنَّهُ يَغْسِلُ مَا أَمَرَ اَللَّهُ بِمَسْحِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of narrators, from Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn bin Abi Al-Khattab, from Al-Hakam bin Miskin, from Muhammad bin Marwan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "A man may live for sixty or seventy years, yet Allah (swt) does not accept a single prayer from him." I asked: "How is that?" Imam (a.s) replied: "Because he washes what Allah (swt) has commanded to be wiped."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ya‘qub narrated from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ali bin Isma‘il, from Ali bin Al-Nu‘man, from Al-Qasim bin Muhammad, from Ja‘far bin Sulayman, from his uncle, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (a.s): 'May I be your ransom, if a man's shoe is torn and he inserts his hand to wipe over the tops of his feet, will that suffice him?'" Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَمِّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ يَكُونُ خُفُّ اَلرَّجُلِ مُخَرَّقاً فَيُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ فَيَمْسَحُ ظَهْرَ قَدَمَيْهِ أَ يُجْزِيهِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ya‘qub narrated from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ali bin Isma‘il, from Ali bin Al-Nu‘man, from Al-Qasim bin Muhammad, from Ja‘far bin Sulayman, from his uncle, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (a.s): 'May I be your ransom, if a man's shoe is torn and he inserts his hand to wipe over the tops of his feet, will that suffice him?'" Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id narrated from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
(Narrator said) Imam (a.s) said to me: "If you were to perform ablution and wash the feet instead of wiping them, and you intended that this washing was part of the obligatory acts, it would not count as valid ablution." Then Imam (a.s) said: "Begin by wiping over the feet. If it occurs to you to wash them and you do so, then wipe over them afterward, so that the obligatory act is the final one performed."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي:« لَوْ أَنَّكَ تَوَضَّأْتَ فَجَعَلْتَ مَسْحَ اَلرِّجْلَيْنِ غَسْلاً ثُمَّ أَضْمَرْتَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنَ اَلْمَفْرُوضِ لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَلِكَ بِوُضُوءٍ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« اِبْدَأْ بِالْمَسْحِ عَلَى اَلرِّجْلَيْنِ فَإِنْ بَدَا لَكَ غَسْلٌ فَغَسَلْتَهُ فَامْسَحْ بَعْدَهُ لِيَكُونَ آخِرَ ذَلِكَ اَلْمَفْرُوضِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id narrated from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Narrator said) Imam (a.s) said to me: "If you were to perform ablution and wash the feet instead of wiping them, and you intended that this washing was part of the obligatory acts, it would not count as valid ablution." Then Imam (a.s) said: "Begin by wiping over the feet. If it occurs to you to wash them and you do so, then wipe over them afterward, so that the obligatory act is the final one performed."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya narrated from Ahmad bin Al-Hasan bin Ali bin Faddal, from Amr bin Sa‘id Al-Madaini, from Musaddiq bin Sadaqah, from Ammar bin Musa, from Abu Abdullah (a.s)
Imam Al Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who performs ablution but does not wash his feet, instead immersing them in water. Imam (a.s) said: "That suffices for him."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَتَوَضَّأُ اَلْوُضُوءَ كُلَّهُ إِلاَّ رِجْلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَخُوضُ اَلْمَاءَ بِهِمَا خَوْضاً قَالَ« أَجْزَأَهُ ذَلِكَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya narrated from Ahmad bin Al-Hasan bin Ali bin Faddal, from Amr bin Sa‘id Al-Madaini, from Musaddiq bin Sadaqah, from Ammar bin Musa, from Abu Abdullah (a.s)
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Al Sadiq (a.s) said regarding a man who performs ablution but does not wash his feet, instead immersing them in water. Imam (a.s) said: "That suffices for him."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris and Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Abdullah, from Hammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Nuʿman, from Ghalib ibn al-Hudhayl, who said:
I asked Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) about the statement of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic: "And wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6) - is it recited in the genitive case (Jar) or the accusative case (Nasb)? Imam (a.s) replied: "It is in the genitive case (Jar)."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ وَ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ اَلْهُذَيْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ« وَ اِمْسَحُوا بِرُؤُسِكُمْ وَ أَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى اَلْكَعْبَيْنِ» عَلَى اَلْخَفْضِ هِيَ أَمْ عَلَى اَلنَّصْبِ قَالَ« بَلْ هِيَ عَلَى اَلْخَفْضِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris and Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Abdullah, from Hammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Nuʿman, from Ghalib ibn al-Hudhayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) about the statement of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic: "And wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6) - is it recited in the genitive case (Jar) or the accusative case (Nasb)? Imam (a.s) replied: "It is in the genitive case (Jar)."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Ali ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Maysar, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is one" and Imam (a.s) described the ankle (Kaʿb) as being on the top of the foot.
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُيَسِّرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْوُضُوءُ وَاحِدٌ» وَ وَصَفَ اَلْكَعْبَ فِي ظَهْرِ اَلْقَدَمِ.
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Ali ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Maysar, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is one" and Imam (a.s) described the ankle (Kaʿb) as being on the top of the foot.

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ahmad ibn Hamzah and al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn ʿUthman, from Maysar, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Shall I demonstrate to you the ablution (Wuduʾ) of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)?" Imam (a.s) then took a handful of water and poured it over his face. Then, Imam (a.s) took another handful and poured it over his arm. Imam (a.s) then took another handful and poured it over his other arm. After that, Imam (a.s) wiped his head and his feet. Imam (a.s) placed his hand on the top of his foot and said: "This is the ankle (Kaʿb).” Imam (a.s) then gestured with his hand to the lower part of the heel and said: "This is the shinbone (Zunbub)."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ وَ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُيَسِّرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« أَلاَ أَحْكِي لَكُمْ وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفّاً مِنْ مَاءٍ فَصَبَّهَا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفّاً فَصَبَّهَا عَلَى ذِرَاعِهِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفّاً آخَرَ فَصَبَّهَا عَلَى ذِرَاعِهِ اَلْأُخْرَى ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ وَ قَدَمَيْهِ ثُمَّ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِ اَلْقَدَمِ ثُمَّ قَالَ« هَذَا هُوَ اَلْكَعْبُ» قَالَ وَ أَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى أَسْفَلِ اَلْعُرْقُوبِ ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّ هَذَا هُوَ اَلظُّنْبُوبُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ahmad ibn Hamzah and al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn ʿUthman, from Maysar, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Shall I demonstrate to you the ablution (Wuduʾ) of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)?" Imam (a.s) then took a handful of water and poured it over his face. Then, Imam (a.s) took another handful and poured it over his arm. Imam (a.s) then took another handful and poured it over his other arm. After that, Imam (a.s) wiped his head and his feet. Imam (a.s) placed his hand on the top of his foot and said: "This is the ankle (Kaʿb).” Imam (a.s) then gestured with his hand to the lower part of the heel and said: "This is the shinbone (Zunbub)."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Udhaynah, from Zurarah and Bukayr, the sons of Aʿyan:
They asked Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) about the ablution (Wuduʾ) of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family). Imam (a.s) requested a basin or bowl with water, then demonstrated the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) until Imam (a.s) reached the part where Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: “And wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles.” (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6) Imam (a.s) said: "If one wipes any part of his head or any part of his feet (up to the ankles), from between the ankles to the ends of the toes, it suffices him." We said: "May Allah (swt) make you prosper; where are the ankles?" Imam (a.s) said: "Here," pointing to the joint below the shinbone and above the foot. They said: "This is not it; what is this?" Imam (a.s) said: "This is the shinbone."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ بُكَيْرٍ اِبْنَيْ أَعْيَنَ: أَنَّهُمَا سَأَلاَ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ وُضُوءِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَدَعَا بِطَسْتٍ أَوْ تَوْرٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ ثُمَّ حَكَى وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِلَى أَنِ اِنْتَهَى إِلَى آخِرِ مَا قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى« وَ اِمْسَحُوا بِرُؤُسِكُمْ وَ أَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى اَلْكَعْبَيْنِ»« فَإِذَا مَسَحَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ رَأْسِهِ أَوْ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ رِجْلَيْهِ( قدميه) مَا بَيْنَ اَلْكَعْبَيْنِ إِلَى آخِرِ أَطْرَافِ اَلْأَصَابِعِ فَقَدْ أَجْزَأَهُ» قُلْنَا أَصْلَحَكَ اَللَّهُ فَأَيْنَ اَلْكَعْبَانِ قَالَ« هَاهُنَا» يَعْنِي اَلْمَفْصِلَ دُونَ عَظْمِ اَلسَّاقِ فَقَالاَ هَذَا مَا هُوَ قَالَ «هَذَا عَظْمُ اَلسَّاقِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Udhaynah, from Zurarah and Bukayr, the sons of Aʿyan:
thaqalaynMatn: They asked Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) about the ablution (Wuduʾ) of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family). Imam (a.s) requested a basin or bowl with water, then demonstrated the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) until Imam (a.s) reached the part where Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: “And wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles.” (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6) Imam (a.s) said: "If one wipes any part of his head or any part of his feet (up to the ankles), from between the ankles to the ends of the toes, it suffices him." We said: "May Allah (swt) make you prosper; where are the ankles?" Imam (a.s) said: "Here," pointing to the joint below the shinbone and above the foot. They said: "This is not it; what is this?" Imam (a.s) said: "This is the shinbone."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 79
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 53

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "When you place your hand in the water, say: 'In the name of Allah (swt), and by Allah (swt). O Allah (swt), make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves.' And when you finish, say: 'All praise is due to Allah (swt), the Lord of the worlds.' " Imam (a.s) then said: "The ablution (Wuduʾ) of a woman is the same as the ablution of a man, except that the Sunnah is for the woman to begin washing her arms after her face by starting with the inner part of her forearms, while the man begins by washing the outer part of his forearms."
arabicText: فَأَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا وَضَعْتَ يَدَكَ فِي اَلْمَاءِ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اَللَّهِ وَ بِاللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ اَلتَّوَّابِينَ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ اَلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ« اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ اَلْعٰالَمِينَ»». ثُمَّ قَالَ« وَ وُضُوءُ اَلْمَرْأَةِ كَوُضُوءِ اَلرَّجُلِ سَوَاءً إِلاَّ أَنَّ اَلسُّنَّةَ أَنْ تَبْتَدِئَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ فِي غَسْلِ يَدَيْهَا بَعْدَ وَجْهِهَا بِبَاطِنِ ذِرَاعَيْهَا وَ يَبْتَدِئَ اَلرَّجُلُ بِغَسْلِ اَلظَّاهِرِ مِنْهُمَا.».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "When you place your hand in the water, say: 'In the name of Allah (swt), and by Allah (swt). O Allah (swt), make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves.' And when you finish, say: 'All praise is due to Allah (swt), the Lord of the worlds.' " Imam (a.s) then said: "The ablution (Wuduʾ) of a woman is the same as the ablution of a man, except that the Sunnah is for the woman to begin washing her arms after her face by starting with the inner part of her forearms, while the man begins by washing the outer part of his forearms."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad reported to me, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his brother Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil ibn Baziʿ, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Allah (swt), the Exalted, has made it obligatory for women in ablution (Wuduʾ) to begin with the inner part of their forearms, and for men to begin with the outer part of their forearms."
arabicText: فَأَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« فَرَضَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى اَلنِّسَاءِ فِي اَلْوُضُوءِ أَنْ يَبْدَأْنَ بِبَاطِنِ أَذْرُعِهِنَّ وَ فِي اَلرِّجَالِ بِظَاهِرِ اَلذِّرَاعِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad reported to me, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his brother Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil ibn Baziʿ, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Allah (swt), the Exalted, has made it obligatory for women in ablution (Wuduʾ) to begin with the inner part of their forearms, and for men to begin with the outer part of their forearms."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s), from his father, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "A woman does not wipe her head in the same manner as men do. In the morning (Fajr), she wipes her head and removes her head covering. However, during Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and ʿIshaʾ prayers, she wipes only her forelock (Nasiyah)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تَمْسَحُ اَلْمَرْأَةُ بِالرَّأْسِ كَمَا يَمْسَحُ اَلرِّجَالُ إِنَّمَا اَلْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَتْ مَسَحَتْ رَأْسَهَا وَ تَضَعُ اَلْخِمَارَ عَنْهَا فَإِذَا كَانَ اَلظُّهْرُ وَ اَلْعَصْرُ وَ اَلْمَغْرِبُ وَ اَلْعِشَاءُ تَمْسَحُ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s), from his father, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "A woman does not wipe her head in the same manner as men do. In the morning (Fajr), she wipes her head and removes her head covering. However, during Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and ʿIshaʾ prayers, she wipes only her forelock (Nasiyah)."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said that Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) said:
Imam (a.s) said: "It suffices for a woman, when wiping her head, to wipe the front part of it, covering the area of three fingers, and she does not need to remove her head covering."
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَلْمَرْأَةُ يُجْزِيهَا مِنْ مَسْحِ اَلرَّأْسِ أَنْ تَمْسَحَ مُقَدَّمَهُ قَدْرَ ثَلاَثِ أَصَابِعَ وَ لاَ تُلْقِي عَنْهَا خِمَارَهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said that Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "It suffices for a woman, when wiping her head, to wipe the front part of it, covering the area of three fingers, and she does not need to remove her head covering."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 80
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me of this narration from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, Ali ibn Hadid, and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn ʿIsa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah
Zurarah said that Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) said something similar (to the previous narration).
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي بِهَذَا اَلْحَدِيثِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ وَ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ اَلْحَدِيثِ اَلْأَوَّلِ.
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me of this narration from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, Ali ibn Hadid, and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn ʿIsa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah
thaqalaynMatn: Zurarah said that Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) said something similar (to the previous narration).

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 54

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from ʿUthman, from Samaah, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about them both (rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose), and Imam (a.s) said: "They are part of the Sunnah. If you forget them, there is no obligation upon you to repeat (the ablution)."
arabicText: أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُمَا فَقَالَ« هُمَا مِنَ اَلسُّنَّةِ فَإِنْ نَسِيتَهُمَا لَمْ تَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ إِعَادَةٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from ʿUthman, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about them both (rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose), and Imam (a.s) said: "They are part of the Sunnah. If you forget them, there is no obligation upon you to repeat (the ablution)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 81
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from ʿUthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Malik ibn Aʿyan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about someone who performed ablution (Wuduʾ) and forgot to rinse their mouth (Madmada) and sniff water into their nose (Istinshaq), and then remembered after starting their prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَمَّنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَ نَسِيَ اَلْمَضْمَضَةَ وَ اَلاِسْتِنْشَاقَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from ʿUthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Malik ibn Aʿyan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about someone who performed ablution (Wuduʾ) and forgot to rinse their mouth (Madmada) and sniff water into their nose (Istinshaq), and then remembered after starting their prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 81
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "Rinsing the mouth (Madmada) and sniffing water into the nose (Istinshaq) are not part of ablution (Wuduʾ)."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلْمَضْمَضَةُ وَ اَلاِسْتِنْشَاقُ لَيْسَا مِنَ اَلْوُضُوءِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Rinsing the mouth (Madmada) and sniffing water into the nose (Istinshaq) are not part of ablution (Wuduʾ)."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 54

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Shuayb, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about them (rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose), and Imam (a.s) said: "They are part of ablution (Wuduʾ), but if you forget them, you do not need to repeat."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْهُمَا فَقَالَ« هُمَا مِنَ اَلْوُضُوءِ فَإِنْ نَسِيتَهُمَا فَلاَ تُعِدْ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Shuayb, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about them (rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose), and Imam (a.s) said: "They are part of ablution (Wuduʾ), but if you forget them, you do not need to repeat."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "You are not required to sniff water (Istinshaq) or rinse your mouth (Madmada), as they pertain to the inner body."
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ اِسْتِنْشَاقٌ وَ لاَ مَضْمَضَةٌ لِأَنَّهُمَا مِنَ اَلْجَوْفِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "You are not required to sniff water (Istinshaq) or rinse your mouth (Madmada), as they pertain to the inner body."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 81

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for the report narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas ibn Maʿruf, from al-Qasim ibn ʿUrwah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Rinsing the mouth (Madmada) and sniffing water into the nose (Istinshaq) are neither obligatory nor recommended. You are only required to wash what is apparent."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ اَلْمَضْمَضَةُ وَ اَلاِسْتِنْشَاقُ فَرِيضَةً وَ لاَ سُنَّةً إِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ أَنْ تَغْسِلَ مَا ظَهَرَ».
thaqalaynSanad: As for the report narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas ibn Maʿruf, from al-Qasim ibn ʿUrwah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Rinsing the mouth (Madmada) and sniffing water into the nose (Istinshaq) are neither obligatory nor recommended. You are only required to wash what is apparent."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 55

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from al-Qasim ibn ʿUrwah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Rinsing the mouth (Madmada) and sniffing water into the nose (Istinshaq) are among the practices established by the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْمَضْمَضَةُ وَاَلاِسْتِنْشَاقُ مِمَّا سَنَّ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from al-Qasim ibn ʿUrwah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Rinsing the mouth (Madmada) and sniffing water into the nose (Istinshaq) are among the practices established by the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family)."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ṣafwan and Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Fudayl ibn ʿUthman, from Abu ʿUbaydah al-Hadhdhaʾ, who said:
I assisted Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) in performing ablution at Jamʿ (Muzdalifah) after he had relieved himself. I handed Imam (a.s) water, and He (a.s) cleansed himself (Istinjaʾ). Then He (a.s) took a handful of water and washed his face, another handful and washed his right arm, and another handful and washed his left arm. Then, with the remaining moisture, He (a.s) wiped his head and his feet."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ الشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبَانَ عَنْ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ الْحَذَّاءِ قَالَ وَضَّأْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِجَمْعٍ وَقَدْ بَالَ، فَنَاوَلْتُهُ مَاءً فَاسْتَنْجَى، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفًّا فَغَسَلَ بِهِ وَجْهَهُ، وَكَفًّا غَسَلَ بِهِ ذِرَاعَهُ الْأَيْمَنَ، وَكَفًّا غَسَلَ بِهِ ذِرَاعَهُ الْأَيْسَرَ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِفَضْلَةِ النَّدَى رَأْسَهُ وَرِجْلَيْهِ
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ṣafwan and Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Fudayl ibn ʿUthman, from Abu ʿUbaydah al-Hadhdhaʾ, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I assisted Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) in performing ablution at Jamʿ (Muzdalifah) after he had relieved himself. I handed Imam (a.s) water, and He (a.s) cleansed himself (Istinjaʾ). Then He (a.s) took a handful of water and washed his face, another handful and washed his right arm, and another handful and washed his left arm. Then, with the remaining moisture, He (a.s) wiped his head and his feet."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Ali ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Maysarah:
Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is (performed by washing) once for each part," and he described the ankle (Kaʿb) as being on the top of the foot.
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْوُضُوءُ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً وَ وَصَفَ اَلْكَعْبَ فِي ظَهْرِ اَلْقَدَمِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Ali ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Maysarah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is (performed by washing) once for each part," and he described the ankle (Kaʿb) as being on the top of the foot.

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ribat, from Yunus ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ) for prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "Once for each part."
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْوُضُوءِ لِلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ« مَرَّةً مَرَّةً».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ribat, from Yunus ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ) for prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "Once for each part."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Karim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ), and Imam (a.s) said: "The ablution of (Imam) Ali (a.s) was only once for each part."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْكَرِيمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْوُضُوءِ فَقَالَ« مَا كَانَ وُضُوءُ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Karim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ), and Imam (a.s) said: "The ablution of (Imam) Ali (a.s) was only once for each part."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for the report narrated by al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Yaʿqub, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ), and Imam (a.s) said: "Twice for each part."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا اَلْخَبَرُ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْوُضُوءِ فَقَالَ« مَثْنَى مَثْنَى».
thaqalaynSanad: As for the report narrated by al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Hammad, from Yaʿqub, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ), and Imam (a.s) said: "Twice for each part."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for the other report narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ṣafwan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is twice for each part."
arabicText: وَ اَلْخَبَرُ اَلْآخَرُ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْوُضُوءُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى».
thaqalaynSanad: As for the other report narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ṣafwan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is twice for each part."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 83
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from al-Qasim ibn ʿUrwah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is twice for each part. Whoever adds beyond that will not be rewarded for it." Imam (a.s) then demonstrated for us the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family): Imam (a.s) washed his face once, his arms once, and wiped his head with the remaining moisture from his ablution, and wiped his feet.
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْوُضُوءُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى مَنْ زَادَ لَمْ يُؤْجَرْ عَلَيْهِ» وَ حَكَى لَنَا وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوئِهِ وَ رِجْلَيْهِ.
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from al-Qasim ibn ʿUrwah, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) is twice for each part. Whoever adds beyond that will not be rewarded for it." Imam (a.s) then demonstrated for us the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family): Imam (a.s) washed his face once, his arms once, and wiped his head with the remaining moisture from his ablution, and wiped his feet.

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah and Bukayr:
They both asked Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) about the ablution (Wuduʾ) of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family). Imam (a.s) then requested a basin and narrated the description of ablution until he said: We had asked: "May Allah (swt) rectify your affairs, is one handful of water sufficient for the face, and one handful for the arm?" Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes, if you use it thoroughly. Two handfuls are sufficient for all of it."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ بُكَيْرٍ: أَنَّهُمَا سَأَلاَ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ وُضُوءِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَدَعَا بِطَسْتٍ وَ ذَكَرَ اَلْحَدِيثَ إِلَى أَنْ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا أَصْلَحَكَ اَللَّهُ فَالْغُرْفَةُ اَلْوَاحِدَةُ تُجْزِي لِلْوَجْهِ وَ غُرْفَةٌ لِلذِّرَاعِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ إِذَا بَالَغْتَ فِيهَا وَ اَلثِّنْتَانِ تَأْتِيَانِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah and Bukayr:
thaqalaynMatn: They both asked Abu Jaʿfar (a.s) about the ablution (Wuduʾ) of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family). Imam (a.s) then requested a basin and narrated the description of ablution until he said: We had asked: "May Allah (swt) rectify your affairs, is one handful of water sufficient for the face, and one handful for the arm?" Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes, if you use it thoroughly. Two handfuls are sufficient for all of it."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for the report narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Ismaʿil ibn Ziyad and al-Abbas ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Bashir, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) once is obligatory, twice earns no reward, and the third is an innovation."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا اَلْحَدِيثُ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ زِيَادٍ وَاَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلْوُضُوءُ وَاحِدَةٌ فَرْضٌ وَ اِثْنَتَانِ لاَ يُؤْجَرُ وَ اَلثَّالِثَةُ بِدْعَةٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: As for the report narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Ismaʿil ibn Ziyad and al-Abbas ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Bashir, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Ablution (Wuduʾ) once is obligatory, twice earns no reward, and the third is an innovation."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qandi, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "Whoever is not certain that one (washing) in ablution (Wuduʾ) suffices him will not be rewarded for performing it twice."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ اَلْقَنْدِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَيْقِنْ أَنَّ وَاحِدَةً مِنَ اَلْوُضُوءِ تُجْزِيهِ لَمْ يُؤْجَرْ عَلَى اَلثِّنْتَيْنِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qandi, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "Whoever is not certain that one (washing) in ablution (Wuduʾ) suffices him will not be rewarded for performing it twice."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Ṣaffar, from Yaʿqub ibn Yazid, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washshaʾ, from Dawud ibn Zurabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ), and Imam (a.s) said to me: "Perform it three times." Imam (a.s) then said to me: "Do you not witness Baghdad and their armies?" I replied: "Yes." Imam (a.s) continued: "One day, I was performing ablution in the house of al-Mahdi, and one of them saw me, though I was unaware of his presence. He said, 'Whoever claims you are so-and-so is lying, as you perform this type of ablution.' I said to him, 'By Allah (swt), I was commanded to do this.' "
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ زُرْبِيٍّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْوُضُوءِ فَقَالَ لِي« تَوَضَّأْ ثَلاَثاً» قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي« أَ لَيْسَ تَشْهَدُ بَغْدَادَ وَ عَسَاكِرَهُمْ» قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَ فَكُنْتُ يَوْماً أَتَوَضَّأُ فِي دَارِ اَلْمَهْدِيِّ فَرَآنِي بَعْضُهُمْ وَ أَنَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ فَقَالَ كَذَبَ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّكَ فُلاَنِيٌّ وَ أَنْتَ تَتَوَضَّأُ هَذَا اَلْوُضُوءَ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لِهَذَا وَ اَللَّهِ أَمَرَنِي.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Ṣaffar, from Yaʿqub ibn Yazid, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washshaʾ, from Dawud ibn Zurabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about ablution (Wuduʾ), and Imam (a.s) said to me: "Perform it three times." Imam (a.s) then said to me: "Do you not witness Baghdad and their armies?" I replied: "Yes." Imam (a.s) continued: "One day, I was performing ablution in the house of al-Mahdi, and one of them saw me, though I was unaware of his presence. He said, 'Whoever claims you are so-and-so is lying, as you perform this type of ablution.' I said to him, 'By Allah (swt), I was commanded to do this.' "

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, who raised it to Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (a.s)
Imam (a.s) said: regarding wiping the feet and the head. Imam (a.s) said: "Wiping the head is once, from the front of the head to the back. As for wiping the feet, it includes their upper and lower surfaces."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي مَسْحِ اَلْقَدَمَيْنِ وَ مَسْحِ اَلرَّأْسِ قَالَ« مَسْحُ اَلرَّأْسِ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْ مُقَدَّمِ اَلرَّأْسِ وَ مُؤَخَّرِهِ وَ مَسْحُ اَلْقَدَمَيْنِ ظَاهِرُهُمَا وَ بَاطِنُهُمَا».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, who raised it to Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (a.s)
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: regarding wiping the feet and the head. Imam (a.s) said: "Wiping the head is once, from the front of the head to the back. As for wiping the feet, it includes their upper and lower surfaces."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from Yunus, who said:
(Narrator said) "Someone who saw Abu al-Hasan (a.s) at Mina informed me that he would wipe the upper part of his feet, from the top of the foot to the ankle, and from the ankle back to the top of the foot."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ الشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ رَأَى أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِمِنًى يَمْسَحُ ظَهْرَ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنْ أَعْلَى الْقَدَمِ إِلَى الْكَعْبِ وَمِنَ الْكَعْبِ إِلَى أَعْلَى الْقَدَمِ.
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from Yunus, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Narrator said) "Someone who saw Abu al-Hasan (a.s) at Mina informed me that he would wipe the upper part of his feet, from the top of the foot to the ankle, and from the ankle back to the top of the foot."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 85

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in wiping the feet either forward or backward."
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِمَسْحِ اَلْقَدَمَيْنِ مُقْبِلاً وَ مُدْبِراً».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in wiping the feet either forward or backward."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: The narration reported from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family): "Indeed, actions are judged by intentions, and for every person is that which they intended."
arabicText: اَلْخَبَرُ اَلْمَرْوِيُّ عَنِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« إِنَّمَا اَلْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ وَ إِنَّمَا لاِمْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى» اَلْخَبَرَ.
thaqalaynMatn: The narration reported from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family): "Indeed, actions are judged by intentions, and for every person is that which they intended."

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī

thaqalaynMatn: By his statement (a.s): "Indeed, usury (Riba) is only in deferred payment."

arabicText: بِقَوْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِنَّمَا اَلْمَاءُ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ». قال الآخرون من الصحابة هذا الخبر منسوخ فلولا أن الفريقين رأوا هذه اللفظة مانعة من وجوب الغسل من غير انزال لما احتج بالخبر نافوا وجوب الغسل ولا ادعى نسخه الباقون.
thaqalaynMatn: By his statement (a.s): "Indeed, water is only due to water."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, and the Shaykh also informed me from Ahmad ibn Jaʿfar, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man wearing a tight ring and not knowing whether water reaches underneath it or not - what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "If he knows that water does not reach under it, then he should remove it when performing ablution (Wuduʾ)."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلْخَاتَمُ اَلضَّيِّقُ لاَ يَدْرِي هَلْ يَجْرِي اَلْمَاءُ تَحْتَهُ أَمْ لاَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« إِنْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ اَلْمَاءَ لاَ يَدْخُلُهُ فَلْيُخْرِجْهُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, and the Shaykh also informed me from Ahmad ibn Jaʿfar, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Jaʿfar (a.s), who said:

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad reported to me, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Jaʿfar, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman wearing bracelets or armlets on part of her forearm, unsure whether water reaches underneath them when she performs ablution (Wuduʾ) or Ghusl. Imam (a.s) said: "She should move them so that the water reaches underneath, or she should remove them." I also asked Imam (a.s) about a tight ring, where one does not know if water reaches underneath it during ablution. What should be done? Imam (a.s) said: "If it is known that water does not reach underneath, then it must be removed during ablution."
arabicText: وَ أَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ عَلَيْهَا اَلسِّوَارُ وَ اَلدُّمْلُجُ فِي بَعْضِ ذِرَاعِهَا لاَ تَدْرِي أَ يَجْرِي اَلْمَاءُ تَحْتَهُمَا أَمْ لاَ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَتْ أَوِ اِغْتَسَلَتْ قَالَ قَالَ« تُحَرِّكُهُ حَتَّى تُدْخِلَ اَلْمَاءَ تَحْتَهُ أَوْ تَنْزِعُهُ» وَ عَنِ اَلْخَاتَمِ اَلضَّيِّقِ لاَ يَدْرِي هَلْ يَجْرِي اَلْمَاءُ تَحْتَهُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَمْ لاَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «إِنْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ اَلْمَاءَ لاَ يَدْخُلُهُ فَلْيُخْرِجْهُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad reported to me, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Jaʿfar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman wearing bracelets or armlets on part of her forearm, unsure whether water reaches underneath them when she performs ablution (Wuduʾ) or Ghusl. Imam (a.s) said: "She should move them so that the water reaches underneath, or she should remove them." I also asked Imam (a.s) about a tight ring, where one does not know if water reaches underneath it during ablution. What should be done? Imam (a.s) said: "If it is known that water does not reach underneath, then it must be removed during ablution."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from al-Ahwal, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "I come out of the restroom and cleanse myself with water, but my clothing touches the water that I used for Istinjaʾ. Is there any harm in this?" Imam (a.s) replied: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: فَأَخْبَرَنِي اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنِ اَلْأَحْوَلِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ أَخْرُجُ مِنَ اَلْخَلاَءِ فَأَسْتَنْجِي بِالْمَاءِ فَيَقَعُ ثَوْبِي فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْمَاءِ اَلَّذِي اِسْتَنْجَيْتُ بِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from al-Ahwal, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "I come out of the restroom and cleanse myself with water, but my clothing touches the water that I used for Istinjaʾ. Is there any harm in this?" Imam (a.s) replied: "There is no harm in it."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn ʿIsa, from Ribʿi ibn Abdullah, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about a man in a state of major ritual impurity (Janabah) who performs Ghusl, and water splashes from his body into the container. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it. For - ‘Allah (swt) has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty.’" (Surat al-Hajj, 22:78).
arabicText: وَبِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ اَلْجُنُبِ يَغْتَسِلُ فَيَنْتَضِحُ اَلْمَاءُ فِي إِنَائِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ« مٰا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي اَلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ»».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Yaʿqub, from Muhammad ibn Ismaʿil, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn ʿIsa, from Ribʿi ibn Abdullah, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about a man in a state of major ritual impurity (Janabah) who performs Ghusl, and water splashes from his body into the container. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it. For - ‘Allah (swt) has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty.’" (Surat al-Hajj, 22:78).

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ali ibn al-Nuʿman and Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Layth al-Muradi, from Abd al-Karim ibn ʿUtbah al-Hashimi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about a man whose garment touches the water used for Istinjaʾ (cleansing after using the restroom). Does it make his garment impure? Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ اَلْمُرَادِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْكَرِيمِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقَعُ ثَوْبُهُ عَلَى اَلْمَاءِ اَلَّذِي اِسْتَنْجَى بِهِ أَ يُنَجِّسُ ذَلِكَ ثَوْبَهُ فَقَالَ« لاَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Ali ibn al-Nuʿman and Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Layth al-Muradi, from Abd al-Karim ibn ʿUtbah al-Hashimi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about a man whose garment touches the water used for Istinjaʾ (cleansing after using the restroom). Does it make his garment impure? Imam (a.s) said: "No."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
ibn al-Mukhtar, from Burayd ibn Muawiyah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "I perform Ghusl from Janabah, and water falls onto the ground and splashes back onto my garment. Is there any harm in this?" Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ اَلْجَنَابَةِ فَيَقَعُ اَلْمَاءُ عَلَى اَلصَّفَا فَيَنْزُو فَيَقَعُ عَلَى اَلثَّوْبِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: ibn al-Mukhtar, from Burayd ibn Muawiyah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "I perform Ghusl from Janabah, and water falls onto the ground and splashes back onto my garment. Is there any harm in this?" Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn ʿUthman, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If you perform part of your Wuduʾ and then a need arises, causing your Wuduʾ to dry, repeat your Wuduʾ, for Wuduʾ cannot be divided."
arabicText: مَا أَخْبَرَنِي بِهِ اَلشَّيْخُ أَيَّدَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ بَعْضَ وُضُوئِكَ فَعَرَضَتْ لَكَ حَاجَةٌ حَتَّى يَبِسَ وَضُوؤُكَ فَأَعِدْ وُضُوءَكَ فَإِنَّ اَلْوُضُوءَ لاَ يُبَعَّضُ».
thaqalaynSanad: The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah (swt) support him, informed me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn ʿUthman, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If you perform part of your Wuduʾ and then a need arises, causing your Wuduʾ to dry, repeat your Wuduʾ, for Wuduʾ cannot be divided."

chapter: Chapter on the Description of Ablution (Wudu)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "Sometimes I perform Wuduʾ, but the water runs out, so I call for the servant girl, and she takes a long time bringing the water, causing my Wuduʾ to dry. What should I do?" Imam (a.s) said: "Repeat it."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رُبَّمَا تَوَضَّأْتُ فَنَفِدَ اَلْمَاءُ فَدَعَوْتُ اَلْجَارِيَةَ فَأَبْطَأَتْ عَلَيَّ بِالْمَاءِ فَيَجِفُّ وَضُوئِي قَالَ« أَعِدْ».
thaqalaynSanad: Through the same chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Saʿid, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "Sometimes I perform Wuduʾ, but the water runs out, so I call for the servant girl, and she takes a long time bringing the water, causing my Wuduʾ to dry. What should I do?" Imam (a.s) said: "Repeat it."
