chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who touches his private part during the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَعْبَثُ بِذَكَرِهِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who touches his private part during the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 368

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from him, from his brother Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who touches his private part, or his genitals, or below that while he is standing in prayer. Should he repeat his wudu (ablution)? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in that. It is only a part of his body."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمَسُّ ذَكَرَهُ أَوْ فَرْجَهُ أَوْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي أَ يُعِيدُ وُضُوءَهُ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from him, from his brother Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who touches his private part, or his genitals, or below that while he is standing in prayer. Should he repeat his wudu (ablution)? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in that. It is only a part of his body."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 368
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 41

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: "Wudu (ablution) is not obligatory except due to defecation, urination, a sound-breaking wind that is audible, or silent wind that has a noticeable odour."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُوجِبُ اَلْوُضُوءَ إِلاَّ غَائِطٌ أَوْ بَوْلٌ أَوْ ضَرْطَةٌ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهَا أَوْ فَسْوَةٌ تَجِدُ رِيحَهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: "Wudu (ablution) is not obligatory except due to defecation, urination, a sound-breaking wind that is audible, or silent wind that has a noticeable odour."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 368
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 41

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from him, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, Satan blows into the anus of a person until it seems to him that wind has exited, but his wudu (ablution) is not invalidated unless he hears the sound of the wind or detects its odor."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِنَّ اَلشَّيْطَانَ يَنْفُخُ فِي دُبُرِ اَلْإِنْسَانِ حَتَّى يُخَيَّلَ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنْهُ رِيحٌ وَ لاَ يَنْقُضُ وُضُوءَهُ إِلاَّ رِيحٌ يَسْمَعُهَا أَوْ يَجِدُ رِيحَهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from him, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, Satan blows into the anus of a person until it seems to him that wind has exited, but his wudu (ablution) is not invalidated unless he hears the sound of the wind or detects its odor."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 369
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 41

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdullah, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
I said to Imam (a.s): "I feel wind in my stomach until I think that it has exited." Imam (a.s) replied: "You do not need to perform wudu unless you hear the sound or detect the odor." Then Imam (a.s) added: "Indeed, Iblis comes and sits between a man's buttocks and passes wind to cause him doubt."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَجِدُ اَلرِّيحَ فِي بَطْنِي حَتَّى أَظُنُّ أَنَّهَا قَدْ خَرَجَتْ فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ وُضُوءٌ حَتَّى تَسْمَعَ اَلصَّوْتَ أَوْ تَجِدَ اَلرِّيحَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ يَجِيءُ فَيَجْلِسُ بَيْنَ أَلْيَتَيِ اَلرَّجُلِ فَيَفْسُو لِيُشَكِّكَهُ
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdullah, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): "I feel wind in my stomach until I think that it has exited." Imam (a.s) replied: "You do not need to perform wudu unless you hear the sound or detect the odor." Then Imam (a.s) added: "Indeed, Iblis comes and sits between a man's buttocks and passes wind to cause him doubt."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahboub narrated from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Safwan, who said:
A man asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s) while I was present. He said: "I have a wound at my anus (perianal). I perform ablution (wudu) and then clean myself, but afterward, I notice moisture and yellowish discharge coming out of the wound. Should I repeat the ablution?" Abu al-Hasan (a.s) asked: "Did you clean it properly?" The man replied: "Yes." Abu al-Hasan (a.s) said: "No, do not repeat the ablution. Simply sprinkle it with water, and you do not need to repeat the ablution."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا حَاضِرٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ بِي جُرْحاً فِي مَقْعَدَتِي فَأَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ أَسْتَنْجِي ثُمَّ أَجِدُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ اَلنَّدَى وَاَلصُّفْرَةَ تَخْرُجُ مِنَ اَلْمَقْعَدَةِ فَأُعِيدُ اَلْوُضُوءَ قَالَ« أَنْقَيْتَ» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ« لاَ وَ لَكِنْ رُشَّهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَ لاَ تُعِدِ اَلْوُضُوءَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahboub narrated from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Safwan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: A man asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s) while I was present. He said: "I have a wound at my anus (perianal). I perform ablution (wudu) and then clean myself, but afterward, I notice moisture and yellowish discharge coming out of the wound. Should I repeat the ablution?" Abu al-Hasan (a.s) asked: "Did you clean it properly?" The man replied: "Yes." Abu al-Hasan (a.s) said: "No, do not repeat the ablution. Simply sprinkle it with water, and you do not need to repeat the ablution."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Abdullah al-Razi narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Saif ibn Amira, from Isa ibn Umar, the servant of the Ansar:
He (Narrator) asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about whether it is permissible for a man to shake hands with a Magian (Zoroastrian). Abu Abdullah (a.s) replied: "No." Then he asked: "Should he perform ablution (wudu) if he shakes hands with them?" Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "Yes, shaking hands with them invalidates the ablution."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلرَّازِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ مَوْلَى اَلْأَنْصَارِ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَافِحَ اَلْمَجُوسِيَّ فَقَالَ« لاَ» فَسَأَلَهُ أَ يَتَوَضَّأُ إِذَا صَافَحَهُمْ قَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنَّ مُصَافَحَتَهُمْ تَنْقُضُ اَلْوُضُوءَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Abdullah al-Razi narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Saif ibn Amira, from Isa ibn Umar, the servant of the Ansar:
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about whether it is permissible for a man to shake hands with a Magian (Zoroastrian). Abu Abdullah (a.s) replied: "No." Then he asked: "Should he perform ablution (wudu) if he shakes hands with them?" Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "Yes, shaking hands with them invalidates the ablution."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Hariz, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "If a man experiences continuous dripping of urine or blood while in prayer, he should prepare a pouch, place cotton inside it, then tie it around himself and insert his private part into it. Then he should pray, combining the two prayers of Dhuhr and Asr by delaying Dhuhr and hastening Asr, with one Adhan and two Iqamahs. Similarly, he should delay Maghrib and hasten Isha with one Adhan and two Iqamahs. He should also follow this method for Fajr (morning prayer)."
arabicText: وَ رَوَى حَرِيزٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« إِذَا كَانَ اَلرَّجُلُ يَقْطُرُ مِنْهُ اَلْبَوْلُ وَ اَلدَّمُ إِذَا كَانَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اِتَّخَذَ كِيساً وَ جَعَلَ فِيهِ قُطْناً ثُمَّ عَلَّقَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ أَدْخَلَ ذَكَرَهُ فِيهِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ اَلصَّلاَتَيْنِ اَلظُّهْرِ وَ اَلْعَصْرِ يُؤَخِّرُ اَلظُّهْرَ وَ يُعَجِّلُ اَلْعَصْرَ بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنِ وَ يُؤَخِّرُ اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ يُعَجِّلُ اَلْعِشَاءَ بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنِ وَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي اَلصُّبْحِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Hariz, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If a man experiences continuous dripping of urine or blood while in prayer, he should prepare a pouch, place cotton inside it, then tie it around himself and insert his private part into it. Then he should pray, combining the two prayers of Dhuhr and Asr by delaying Dhuhr and hastening Asr, with one Adhan and two Iqamahs. Similarly, he should delay Maghrib and hasten Isha with one Adhan and two Iqamahs. He should also follow this method for Fajr (morning prayer)."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hanan ibn Sudayr:
He (Narrator) said: I heard a man asking Abu Abdullah (a.s): "Sometimes I urinate and cannot find water, and this causes me great distress." Abu Abdullah (a.s), replied: "If you urinate and clean yourself, then wipe your private part with your saliva. If you later feel anything, say: 'This is from that.'"
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رُبَّمَا بُلْتُ فَلاَ أَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلْمَاءِ وَ يَشْتَدُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ« إِذَا بُلْتَ وَ تَمَسَّحْتَ فَامْسَحْ ذَكَرَكَ بِرِيقِكَ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ شَيْئاً فَقُلْ هَذَا مِنْ ذَاكَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hanan ibn Sudayr:
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: I heard a man asking Abu Abdullah (a.s): "Sometimes I urinate and cannot find water, and this causes me great distress." Abu Abdullah (a.s), replied: "If you urinate and clean yourself, then wipe your private part with your saliva. If you later feel anything, say: 'This is from that.'"

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked about a man who performs ablution and then touches the inside of his anus. Imam (a.s) replied: "His ablution is invalidated. If he touches the inside of his urethra, he must repeat the ablution. If he was in prayer, he must interrupt the prayer, perform ablution again, and repeat the prayer. And if he opens his urethra, he must repeat the ablution and the prayer."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّ بَاطِنَ دُبُرِهِ قَالَ« نَقَضَ وُضُوءَهُ وَ إِنْ مَسَّ بَاطِنَ إِحْلِيلِهِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ اَلْوُضُوءَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ قَطَعَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ يَتَوَضَّأُ وَ يُعِيدُ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ فَتَحَ إِحْلِيلَهُ أَعَادَ اَلْوُضُوءَ وَ أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about a man who performs ablution and then touches the inside of his anus. Imam (a.s) replied: "His ablution is invalidated. If he touches the inside of his urethra, he must repeat the ablution. If he was in prayer, he must interrupt the prayer, perform ablution again, and repeat the prayer. And if he opens his urethra, he must repeat the ablution and the prayer."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha’:
I heard Abu al-Hasan (a.s), say that Abu Abdullah (a.s), used to say regarding a man who inserts his hand into his nose and finds blood on five of his fingers: "He should clean it, and he does not need to repeat the ablution."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ كَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ فِي أَنْفِهِ فَيُصِيبُ خَمْسَ أَصَابِعِهِ اَلدَّمُ قَالَ« يُنَقِّيهِ وَ لاَ يُعِيدُ اَلْوُضُوءَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha’:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu al-Hasan (a.s), say that Abu Abdullah (a.s), used to say regarding a man who inserts his hand into his nose and finds blood on five of his fingers: "He should clean it, and he does not need to repeat the ablution."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad, from one of the Imams (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who has sores that continue to bleed - how should he pray? Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray even if the blood is flowing."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُخْرَجُ بِهِ الْقُرُوحُ لَا تَزَالُ تَدْمِي، كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي؟ قَالَ: يُصَلِّي وَإِنْ كَانَتِ الدِّمَاءُ تَسِيلُ.
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad, from one of the Imams (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who has sores that continue to bleed - how should he pray? Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray even if the blood is flowing."

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abu Hilal:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), whether nosebleed, vomiting, and plucking armpit hair invalidate wudu. Imam (a.s) said: “What do you have to do with this? This is the saying of Mughira ibn Sa'id - may Allah (swt) curse Mughira. It is sufficient for you, in the case of nosebleed and vomiting, to wash it off, and you do not need to repeat the wudu.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ يَنْقُضُ اَلرُّعَافُ وَ اَلْقَيْءُ وَ نَتْفُ اَلْإِبْطِ اَلْوُضُوءَ فَقَالَ« وَ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِهَذَا فَهَذَا قَوْلُ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ لَعَنَ اَللَّهُ اَلْمُغِيرَةَ وَ يُجْزِيكَ مِنَ اَلرُّعَافِ وَ اَلْقَيْءِ أَنْ تَغْسِلَهُ وَ لاَ تُعِيدَ اَلْوُضُوءَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abu Hilal:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), whether nosebleed, vomiting, and plucking armpit hair invalidate wudu. Imam (a.s) said: “What do you have to do with this? This is the saying of Mughira ibn Sa'id - may Allah (swt) curse Mughira. It is sufficient for you, in the case of nosebleed and vomiting, to wash it off, and you do not need to repeat the wudu.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama’ah:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who experiences discharge from his private part, whether it is blood or something else. Imam (a.s) said: “Let him make a pouch, perform wudu, and pray. This is only a trial he has been afflicted with, so he should not repeat (his prayer) except due to an event that necessitates wudu (other than this).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَخَذَهُ تَقْطِيرٌ مِنْ فَرْجِهِ إِمَّا دَمٌ وَ إِمَّا غَيْرُهُ قَالَ« فَلْيَصْنَعْ خَرِيطَةً وَ لْيَتَوَضَّأْ وَ لْيُصَلِّ فَإِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ بَلاَءٌ اُبْتُلِيَ بِهِ فَلاَ يُعِيدَنَّ إِلاَّ مِنَ اَلْحَدَثِ اَلَّذِي يُتَوَضَّأُ مِنْهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama’ah:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who experiences discharge from his private part, whether it is blood or something else. Imam (a.s) said: “Let him make a pouch, perform wudu, and pray. This is only a trial he has been afflicted with, so he should not repeat (his prayer) except due to an event that necessitates wudu (other than this).”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 42

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about a boil that bursts while a man is in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should wipe it and wipe his hand on the wall or the ground, and he does not interrupt his prayer.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلدُّمَّلِ يَكُونُ فِي اَلرَّجُلِ فَيَنْفَجِرُ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« يَمْسَحُهُ وَ يَمْسَحُ يَدَهُ بِالْحَائِطِ أَوْ بِالْأَرْضِ وَ لاَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a boil that bursts while a man is in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “He should wipe it and wipe his hand on the wall or the ground, and he does not interrupt his prayer.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Miskan, from Laith al-Muradi:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “A man has boils and sores, and his skin and clothes are covered with blood and pus. Are his clothes regarded as part of his skin?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray in his clothes, and there is nothing upon him, nor does he need to wash them.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ابْنِ مِسْكَانَ عَنْ لَيْثِ الْمُرَادِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: الرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ بِهِ الدَّمَامِيلُ وَالْقُرُوحُ فَجِلْدُهُ وَثِيَابُهُ مَمْلُوءَةٌ دَمًا وَقَيْحًا، وَثِيَابُهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ جِلْدِهِ؟ قَالَ: يُصَلِّي فِي ثِيَابِهِ وَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَلَا يَغْسِلُهَا.
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Miskan, from Laith al-Muradi:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “A man has boils and sores, and his skin and clothes are covered with blood and pus. Are his clothes regarded as part of his skin?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray in his clothes, and there is nothing upon him, nor does he need to wash them.”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 42

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdus, from al-Husayn ibn Ali, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Laith al-Muradi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about a person who has a nosebleed (continuously) from midday until the night passes. Imam (a.s) said: “He should signal with his head (as a gesture) during each prayer.” And Imam (a.s) said: regarding a man who has severe diarrhea, Imam (a.s) said: “He should also signal with his head.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُبْدُوسٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ لَيْثٍ اَلْمُرَادِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْعَفِ يَرْعُفُ زَوَالَ اَلشَّمْسِ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ اَللَّيْلُ قَالَ« يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً بِرَأْسِهِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ» وَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ اِسْتَفْرَغَهُ بَطْنُهُ قَالَ« يُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdus, from al-Husayn ibn Ali, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Laith al-Muradi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a person who has a nosebleed (continuously) from midday until the night passes. Imam (a.s) said: “He should signal with his head (as a gesture) during each prayer.” And Imam (a.s) said: regarding a man who has severe diarrhea, Imam (a.s) said: “He should also signal with his head.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Abdul-A'la, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about cupping - does it require ablution? Imam (a.s) said: “No, and he does not need to wash the area because the cupper is entrusted, provided he cleans it properly and is not a young boy.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْأَعْلَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْحِجَامَةِ أَ فِيهَا وُضُوءٌ قَالَ« لاَ وَ لاَ يَغْسِلُ مَكَانَهَا لِأَنَّ اَلْحَجَّامَ مُؤْتَمَنٌ إِذَا كَانَ يُنَظِّفُهُ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ صَبِيّاً صَغِيراً».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Abdul-A'la, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about cupping - does it require ablution? Imam (a.s) said: “No, and he does not need to wash the area because the cupper is entrusted, provided he cleans it properly and is not a young boy.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ayyub ibn al-Hurr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who is affected by flowing blood. Imam (a.s) said: “He should perform ablution and repeat the prayer. And if it is not flowing, he should perform ablution and continue from where he left off.” Imam (a.s) said: “This applies even between Safa and Marwah.”
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ اَلْحُرِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَهُ دَمٌ سَائِلٌ قَالَ« يَتَوَضَّأُ وَ يُعِيدُ» قَالَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَائِلاً تَوَضَّأَ وَ بَنَى قَالَ« وَ يُصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ بَيْنَ اَلصَّفَا وَ اَلْمَرْوَةِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ayyub ibn al-Hurr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who is affected by flowing blood. Imam (a.s) said: “He should perform ablution and repeat the prayer. And if it is not flowing, he should perform ablution and continue from where he left off.” Imam (a.s) said: “This applies even between Safa and Marwah.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who performed ablution and then ate meat or fish. I asked: “Can he pray without washing his hands?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. But if he drank milk, he should not pray until he washes his hands and rinses his mouth. And the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, used to pray after eating meat without washing his hands. However, if he drank milk, he would not pray until he washed his hands and rinsed his mouth.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ لَحْماً أَوْ سَمَكاً هَلْ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ يَدَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَبَنٌ لَمْ يُصَلِّ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَ يَدَهُ وَ يَتَمَضْمَضَ وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُصَلِّي وَ قَدْ أَكَلَ اَللَّحْمَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ يَدَهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَبَناً لَمْ يُصَلِّ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَ يَدَهُ وَ يَتَمَضْمَضَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who performed ablution and then ate meat or fish. I asked: “Can he pray without washing his hands?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. But if he drank milk, he should not pray until he washes his hands and rinses his mouth. And the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, used to pray after eating meat without washing his hands. However, if he drank milk, he would not pray until he washed his hands and rinsed his mouth.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Bukayr ibn A'yan:
I asked Abu Ja'far (a.s), about performing ablution due to something that has been altered by fire (cooked food). Imam (a.s) said: “There is no ablution required for it. Ablution is only required for what comes out, not for what goes in.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْوُضُوءِ مِمَّا غَيَّرَتِ اَلنَّارُ فَقَالَ« لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ فِيهِ وُضُوءٌ وَ إِنَّمَا اَلْوُضُوءُ مِمَّا يَخْرُجُ لَيْسَ مِمَّا يَدْخُلُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Bukayr ibn A'yan:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja'far (a.s), about performing ablution due to something that has been altered by fire (cooked food). Imam (a.s) said: “There is no ablution required for it. Ablution is only required for what comes out, not for what goes in.”

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), whether ablution is required after eating food or drinking the milk of cows, camels, and sheep, or after consuming their urine or meat. Imam (a.s) said: “No, ablution is not required for it.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يُتَوَضَّأُ مِنَ اَلطَّعَامِ أَوْ شُرْبِ اَللَّبَنِ أَلْبَانِ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ وَ أَبْوَالِهَا وَ لُحُومِهَا قَالَ« لاَ يُتَوَضَّأُ مِنْهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), whether ablution is required after eating food or drinking the milk of cows, camels, and sheep, or after consuming their urine or meat. Imam (a.s) said: “No, ablution is not required for it.”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 43

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Al-‘Ayyashi Abu Al-Nadr, who said that Muhammad ibn Nusayr reported from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja‘far (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: “The one who suffers from excessive discharge (due to illness) should perform ablution, then return to his prayer and complete what remains of it.”
arabicText: اَلْعَيَّاشِيُّ أَبُو اَلنَّضْرِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ نُصَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« صَاحِبُ اَلْبَطَنِ اَلْغَالِبِ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيُتِمُّ مَا بَقِيَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Al-‘Ayyashi Abu Al-Nadr, who said that Muhammad ibn Nusayr reported from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja‘far (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The one who suffers from excessive discharge (due to illness) should perform ablution, then return to his prayer and complete what remains of it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 373
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 43

chapter: Chapter on Acts That Necessitate Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Nusayr, who said that Muhammad ibn Isa reported from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked about the issue of urine dribbling (incontinence). Imam (a.s) said: "He should use a pouch when he prays."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نُصَيْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ تَقْطِيرِ اَلْبَوْلِ قَالَ« يَجْعَلُ خَرِيطَةً إِذَا صَلَّى».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Nusayr, who said that Muhammad ibn Isa reported from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about the issue of urine dribbling (incontinence). Imam (a.s) said: "He should use a pouch when he prays."

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from one of the Imams (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "When you enter the restroom, say: 'I seek refuge in Allah (swt) from the impure, filthy, evil, and defiling Satan, the accursed.' And when you finish, say: 'All praise is due to Allah (swt), who has relieved me from affliction and removed harm from me.'"
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ اَلْغَائِطَ فَقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ اَلرِّجْسِ اَلنِّجْسِ اَلْخَبِيثِ اَلْمُخْبِثِ اَلشَّيْطَانِ اَلرَّجِيمِ وَ إِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي عَافَانِي مِنَ اَلْبَلاَءِ وَ أَمَاطَ عَنِّي اَلْأَذَى».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from one of the Imams (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "When you enter the restroom, say: 'I seek refuge in Allah (swt) from the impure, filthy, evil, and defiling Satan, the accursed.' And when you finish, say: 'All praise is due to Allah (swt), who has relieved me from affliction and removed harm from me.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 373
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Abdullah ibn Maymun Al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), from his fathers, from (Imam) Ali (a.s):
Whenever He (a.s), exited the restroom, Imam (a.s) would say: "All praise is due to Allah (swt), who granted me its pleasure, preserved its strength in my body, and removed harm from me. What a blessing this is!" He would repeat it three times.
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَزَقَنِي لَذَّتَهُ وَأَبْقَى قُوَّتَهُ فِي جَسَدِي وَأَخْرَجَ عَنِّي أَذَاهُ، يَا لَهَا نِعْمَةٌ ثَلَاثًا.
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Abdullah ibn Maymun Al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), from his fathers, from (Imam) Ali (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Whenever He (a.s), exited the restroom, Imam (a.s) would say: "All praise is due to Allah (swt), who granted me its pleasure, preserved its strength in my body, and removed harm from me. What a blessing this is!" He would repeat it three times.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 373
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa Al-Ubaydi, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hamid:
I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s), say: "Indeed, Commander of the Faithful (a.s), whenever he intended to relieve himself, he would stand at the entrance of the restroom, then look to his right and left towards his two angels and say: 'Step aside from me, for you have from me a promise before Allah (swt) that I will not commit any act (requiring your recording) until I return to you.'"
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى اَلْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِنَّ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ قَضَاءَ اَلْحَاجَةِ وَقَفَ عَلَى بَابِ اَلْمَذْهَبِ ثُمَّ اِلْتَفَتَ يَمِيناً وَ شِمَالاً إِلَى مَلَكَيْهِ فَيَقُولُ« أَمِيطَا عَنِّي فَلَكُمَا اَللَّهُ عَلَيَّ أَنْ لاَ أُحْدِثَ حَدَثاً حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ إِلَيْكُمَا»».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa Al-Ubaydi, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hamid:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s), say: "Indeed, Commander of the Faithful (a.s), whenever he intended to relieve himself, he would stand at the entrance of the restroom, then look to his right and left towards his two angels and say: 'Step aside from me, for you have from me a promise before Allah (swt) that I will not commit any act (requiring your recording) until I return to you.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 373
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Al-Abbas, from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
I heard Abu Ja'far (a.s), say: "Luqman said to his son: 'Prolonged sitting in the restroom causes hemorrhoids.' So, this was written on the door of the lavatory."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لاِبْنِهِ طُولُ اَلْجُلُوسِ عَلَى اَلْخَلاَءِ يُورِثُ اَلْبَاسُورَ فَكُتِبَ هَذَا عَلَى بَابِ اَلْحَشِّ.
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Al-Abbas, from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Ja'far (a.s), say: "Luqman said to his son: 'Prolonged sitting in the restroom causes hemorrhoids.' So, this was written on the door of the lavatory."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 373
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn 'Udhafir, from Umar ibn Yazid:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about reciting tasbih (praises of Allah (swt)) and reading the Quran in the restroom. Imam (a.s) said: "It is not permitted in the lavatory to recite more than Ayat al-Kursi, or to praise Allah (swt), or to recite a verse."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ فِي اَلْمَخْرَجِ وَ قِرَاءَةِ اَلْقُرْآنِ فَقَالَ« لَمْ يُرَخَّصْ فِي اَلْكَنِيفِ فِي أَكْثَرَ مِنْ آيَةِ اَلْكُرْسِيِّ وَ يَحْمَدُ اَللَّهَ أَوْ آيَةٍ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn 'Udhafir, from Umar ibn Yazid:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about reciting tasbih (praises of Allah (swt)) and reading the Quran in the restroom. Imam (a.s) said: "It is not permitted in the lavatory to recite more than Ayat al-Kursi, or to praise Allah (swt), or to recite a verse."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 374
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by al-Haytham ibn Masruq al-Nahdi, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il:
I entered upon Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), and in his house, there was a lavatory facing the qiblah. I heard Imam (a.s) say: "Whoever urinates while facing the qiblah, and then remembers and turns away from it out of reverence and respect for the qiblah, shall not leave that position until Allah (swt) forgives him."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ اَلنَّهْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ كَنِيفٌ مُسْتَقْبِلَ اَلْقِبْلَةِ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ« مَنْ بَالَ حِذَاءَ اَلْقِبْلَةِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فَانْحَرَفَ عَنْهَا إِجْلاَلاً لِلْقِبْلَةِ وَ تَعْظِيماً لَهَا لَمْ يَقُمْ مِنْ مَقْعَدِهِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَغْفِرَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by al-Haytham ibn Masruq al-Nahdi, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il:
thaqalaynMatn: I entered upon Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), and in his house, there was a lavatory facing the qiblah. I heard Imam (a.s) say: "Whoever urinates while facing the qiblah, and then remembers and turns away from it out of reverence and respect for the qiblah, shall not leave that position until Allah (swt) forgives him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 374
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 49

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sa'dan, from Hakam, from a man, who reported from Abu Abdullah(a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s): "Can a man urinate while standing?" Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes, but it is feared that the Shaytan may afflict him (cause harm or madness)." I then asked: "Can a man urinate in water?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, but it is feared that the Shaytan may harm him."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ حَكَمٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ يَبُولُ اَلرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنَّهُ يُتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ يَلْتَبِسَ بِهِ اَلشَّيْطَانُ أَيْ يُخَبِّلَهُ» فَقُلْتُ يَبُولُ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي اَلْمَاءِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ يُتَخَوَّفُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلشَّيْطَانِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sa'dan, from Hakam, from a man, who reported from Abu Abdullah(a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s): "Can a man urinate while standing?" Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes, but it is feared that the Shaytan may afflict him (cause harm or madness)." I then asked: "Can a man urinate in water?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, but it is feared that the Shaytan may harm him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 374
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ali ibn Al-Rayyan ibn Al-Salt, from Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Misma', who reported from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Commander of the Faithful (a.s), said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "It is disliked, or a man is prohibited, from urinating from a rooftop into the air."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّيَّانِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« يُكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَوْ يُنْهَى اَلرَّجُلُ أَنْ يُطَمِّحَ بِبَوْلِهِ مِنَ اَلسَّطْحِ فِي اَلْهَوَاءِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ali ibn Al-Rayyan ibn Al-Salt, from Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Misma', who reported from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Commander of the Faithful (a.s), said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "It is disliked, or a man is prohibited, from urinating from a rooftop into the air."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 374
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Khazzaz, from Ghiyath, from Imam Al Ja’far (a.s), from his father Imam Al Baqir (a.s):
Imam (a.s) disliked entering the restroom while carrying a white dirham (minted with name of Allah (swt)) unless it was tied up.
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ اَلْخَلاَءَ وَ مَعَهُ دِرْهَمٌ أَبْيَضُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَصْرُوراً».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Khazzaz, from Ghiyath, from Imam Al Ja’far (a.s), from his father Imam Al Baqir (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) disliked entering the restroom while carrying a white dirham (minted with name of Allah (swt)) unless it was tied up.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 374
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from his forefathers (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said that the Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: "When one of you uncovers himself to urinate or for any other purpose, let him say; In the name of Allah (swt), for indeed, the Shaytan lowers his gaze."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« إِذَا اِنْكَشَفَ أَحَدُكُمْ لِبَوْلٍ أَوْ غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اَللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اَلشَّيْطَانَ يَغُضُّ بَصَرَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from his forefathers (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said that the Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: "When one of you uncovers himself to urinate or for any other purpose, let him say; In the name of Allah (swt), for indeed, the Shaytan lowers his gaze."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 375
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ahmad, from Al-Barqi, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakooni, from Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s), from his father Imam Al Baqir (a.s), from his forefathers, from (Imam) Ali (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade relieving oneself on the edge of a well whose water is drawn for drinking, or in a river whose water is used for drinking, or under a tree that bears fruit."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« نَهَى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنْ يُتَغَوَّطَ عَلَى شَفِيرِ بِئْرِ مَاءٍ يُسْتَعْذَبُ مِنْهَا أَوْ نَهَرٍ يُسْتَعْذَبُ أَوْ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ فِيهَا ثَمَرَتُهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ahmad, from Al-Barqi, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakooni, from Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s), from his father Imam Al Baqir (a.s), from his forefathers, from (Imam) Ali (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade relieving oneself on the edge of a well whose water is drawn for drinking, or in a river whose water is used for drinking, or under a tree that bears fruit."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 375
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Bukayr ibn A‘yan, from one of the two Imams (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If an impurity occurs in the mosque, there is no harm in performing ablution in the mosque."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ اَلْحَدَثُ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالْوُضُوءِ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Bukayr ibn A‘yan, from one of the two Imams (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If an impurity occurs in the mosque, there is no harm in performing ablution in the mosque."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 375
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 49

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hanan ibn Sudayr, who said:
I heard a man ask Abu ‘Abdullah (a.s), and he said: "I sometimes urinate but cannot find water, and this troubles me." He (Imam (a.s)) said: "If you urinate and wipe yourself, then wipe your private part with your saliva. If you find anything (afterward), say: 'This is from that.'"
arabicText: الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سُدَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي رُبَّمَا بُلْتُ فَلَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ وَيَشْتَدُّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَيَّ. فَقَالَ: إِذَا بُلْتَ وَتَمَسَّحْتَ فَامْسَحْ ذَكَرَكَ بِرِيقِكَ، فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ شَيْئًا فَقُلْ هَذَا مِنْ ذَاكَ.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hanan ibn Sudayr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard a man ask Abu ‘Abdullah (a.s), and he said: "I sometimes urinate but cannot find water, and this troubles me." He (Imam (a.s)) said: "If you urinate and wipe yourself, then wipe your private part with your saliva. If you find anything (afterward), say: 'This is from that.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 375
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Sa‘dan ibn Muslim, from ‘Abd al-Rahim, who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), regarding a eunuch who urinates and experiences difficulty, seeing wetness repeatedly. He (the Imam (a.s)) replied: "He should perform ablution and sprinkle water (on his clothes) once during the day."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحِيمِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلْخَصِيِّ يَبُولُ فَيَلْقَى مِنْ ذَلِكَ شِدَّةً فَيَرَى اَلْبَلَلَ بَعْدَ اَلْبَلَلِ قَالَ« يَتَوَضَّأُ وَ يَنْتَضِحُ فِي اَلنَّهَارِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Sa‘dan ibn Muslim, from ‘Abd al-Rahim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), regarding a eunuch who urinates and experiences difficulty, seeing wetness repeatedly. He (the Imam (a.s)) replied: "He should perform ablution and sprinkle water (on his clothes) once during the day."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 375
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam:
Abu ‘Abdullah (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘O group of Ansar, Allah (swt) has praised you with good words, so what do you do (to deserve these good words)?’ They replied: "We cleanse ourselves with water."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص:« يَا مَعْشَرَ اَلْأَنْصَارِ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ عَلَيْكُمُ اَلثَّنَاءَ فَمَاذَا تَصْنَعُونَ»« قَالُوا نَسْتَنْجِي بِالْمَاءِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu ‘Abdullah (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘O group of Ansar, Allah (swt) has praised you with good words, so what do you do (to deserve these good words)?’ They replied: "We cleanse ourselves with water."

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn ‘Abdus, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Laith al-Muradi, from Abu ‘Abdullah (a.s).
He (Narrator) said: “I asked Imam (a.s) about a man performing istinja’ (cleaning after relieving oneself) using a bone, dung, or a stick. Imam (a.s) replied: "As for the bone and dung, they are the food of the jinn, and this is something they (Jinn) stipulated with the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family." Then Imam (a.s) said: "It is not permissible to use any of those."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُبْدُوسٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ لَيْثٍ اَلْمُرَادِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِسْتِنْجَاءِ اَلرَّجُلِ بِالْعَظْمِ أَوِ اَلْبَعَرِ أَوِ اَلْعُودِ قَالَ« أَمَّا اَلْعَظْمُ وَ اَلرَّوْثُ فَطَعَامُ اَلْجِنِّ وَ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا اِشْتَرَطُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ» فَقَالَ «لاَ يَصْلُحُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn ‘Abdus, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Laith al-Muradi, from Abu ‘Abdullah (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “I asked Imam (a.s) about a man performing istinja’ (cleaning after relieving oneself) using a bone, dung, or a stick. Imam (a.s) replied: "As for the bone and dung, they are the food of the jinn, and this is something they (Jinn) stipulated with the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family." Then Imam (a.s) said: "It is not permissible to use any of those."

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara.
He (Narrator) said: “He (Zurara) used to perform istinja’ (cleaning after relieving oneself) from urine by washing three times, and from feces using clay or pieces of cloth.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ يَسْتَنْجِي مِنَ الْبَوْلِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَمِنَ الْغَائِطِ بِالْمَدَرِ وَالْخِرَقِ.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara.
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “He (Zurara) used to perform istinja’ (cleaning after relieving oneself) from urine by washing three times, and from feces using clay or pieces of cloth.”

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah.
He (Narrator) said: “I heard Abu Ja'far (a.s), say: ‘(Imam) Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s), would cleanse himself after defecation with cotton and would not wash (with water for istinja).’"
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« كَانَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَتَمَسَّحُ مِنَ اَلْغَائِطِ بِالْكُرْسُفِ وَ لاَ يَغْسِلُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah.
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “I heard Abu Ja'far (a.s), say: ‘(Imam) Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s), would cleanse himself after defecation with cotton and would not wash (with water for istinja).’"

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s).
Imam (a.s) said: "Performing istinja (cleansing) with cold water cures hemorrhoids."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَدِّهِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلاِسْتِنْجَاءُ بِالْمَاءِ اَلْبَارِدِ يَقْطَعُ اَلْبَوَاسِيرَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Performing istinja (cleansing) with cold water cures hemorrhoids."

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdul-Rahman ibn Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hamid, from Shihab ibn Abdul-Rabbih, from Abu Abdillah (a.s).
Imam (a.s) said: "Commander of the Faithful (a.s), when performing ablution (wudu), would not allow anyone to pour water for him. It was said to him: 'O Commander of the Faithful, why do you not allow them to pour water for you?' He (Imam Ali (a.s)) replied: 'I do not like to have anyone share in my prayer.'"
arabicText: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ شِهَابِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ لَمْ يَدَعْ أَحَداً يَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ اَلْمَاءَ فَقِيلَ يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِمَ لاَ تَدَعُهُمْ يَصُبُّونَ عَلَيْكَ اَلْمَاءَ فَقَالَ« لاَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ فِي صَلاَتِي أَحَداً»»
thaqalaynSanad: Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdul-Rahman ibn Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abdul-Hamid, from Shihab ibn Abdul-Rabbih, from Abu Abdillah (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Commander of the Faithful (a.s), when performing ablution (wudu), would not allow anyone to pour water for him. It was said to him: 'O Commander of the Faithful, why do you not allow them to pour water for you?' He (Imam Ali (a.s)) replied: 'I do not like to have anyone share in my prayer.'"

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (a.s).
He (Narrator) said: “I asked Imam (a.s) about the purification of a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding (nifas) when she becomes pure but is unable to cleanse herself with water because doing so might cause her harm. Does she have permission to perform ablution (wudu) externally and then dry herself with cotton or a cloth?” Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes, she should cleanse herself internally with cotton or a cloth."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ طَهُورِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ فِي اَلنِّفَاسِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ وَكَانَتْ لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَسْتَنْجِيَ بِالْمَاءِ أَنَّهَا إِنِ اِسْتَنْجَتِ اِعْتَقَرَتْ هَلْ لَهَا رُخْصَةٌ أَنْ تَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ خَارِجٍ وَ تَنْشِفَهُ بِقُطْنٍ أَوْ بِخِرْقَةٍ قَالَ« نَعَمْ لَتُنْقِي مِنْ دَاخِلٍ بِقُطْنٍ أَوْ بِخِرْقَةٍ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “I asked Imam (a.s) about the purification of a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding (nifas) when she becomes pure but is unable to cleanse herself with water because doing so might cause her harm. Does she have permission to perform ablution (wudu) externally and then dry herself with cotton or a cloth?” Imam (a.s) replied: "Yes, she should cleanse herself internally with cotton or a cloth."

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Abd Rabbih, said:
I asked Imam (a.s): "What do you say about a ring (fuss) made from the stones of Zamzam?" Imam (a.s) replied: "There is no harm in it, but when one intends to perform istinja (purification after relieving oneself), he should remove it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي اَلْفَصِّ يُتَّخَذُ مِنْ أَحْجَارِ زَمْزَمَ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا أَرَادَ اَلاِسْتِنْجَاءَ نَزَعَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Abd Rabbih, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s): "What do you say about a ring (fuss) made from the stones of Zamzam?" Imam (a.s) replied: "There is no harm in it, but when one intends to perform istinja (purification after relieving oneself), he should remove it."

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If you mention the name of Allah (swt) (say Bismillah) during wudu (ablution), your entire body becomes purified. However, if you do not mention the name of Allah (swt), only the parts of your body over which (wudu) water passes will be purified."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا سَمَّيْتَ فِي اَلْوُضُوءِ طَهُرَ جَسَدُكَ كُلُّهُ وَ إِذَا لَمْ تُسَمِّ لَمْ يَطْهُرْ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ إِلاَّ مَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اَلْمَاءُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If you mention the name of Allah (swt) (say Bismillah) during wudu (ablution), your entire body becomes purified. However, if you do not mention the name of Allah (swt), only the parts of your body over which (wudu) water passes will be purified."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 377
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Etiquettes of Acts That Require Purification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), said:
I asked Imam (a.s): "How should a man sit when he wants to perform istinja (cleaning after relieving oneself)?" Imam (a.s) replied: "He should sit as he sits for relieving himself." And Imam (a.s) said: "He is only required to wash the part that is visible and is not required to wash the inner part."
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَسْتَنْجِيَ كَيْفَ يَقْعُدُ قَالَ« كَمَا يَقْعُدُ لِلْغَائِطِ» وَ قَالَ« إِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ بَاطِنَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s): "How should a man sit when he wants to perform istinja (cleaning after relieving oneself)?" Imam (a.s) replied: "He should sit as he sits for relieving himself." And Imam (a.s) said: "He is only required to wash the part that is visible and is not required to wash the inner part."
