Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 119

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from some of our companions, from Abu 'Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "If a piece is severed from a man's body, it is considered a dead body (maytah). If someone touches it, then any part of it that contains bone requires ghusl for the one who touches it. However, if it does not contain bone, then no ghusl is required."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا قُطِعَ مِنَ اَلرَّجُلِ قِطْعَةٌ فَهِيَ مَيْتَةٌ فَإِذَا مَسَّهُ إِنْسَانٌ فَكُلُّ مَا كَانَ فِيهِ عَظْمٌ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ عَلَى مَنْ يَمَسُّهُ اَلْغُسْلُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ عَظْمٌ فَلاَ غُسْلَ عَلَيْهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from some of our companions, from Abu 'Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If a piece is severed from a man's body, it is considered a dead body (maytah). If someone touches it, then any part of it that contains bone requires ghusl for the one who touches it. However, if it does not contain bone, then no ghusl is required."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 455
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "Touching the deceased at the time of death, after the washing (ghusl), and kissing them - there is no harm in it."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَسُّ اَلْمَيِّتِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ وَ بَعْدَ غُسْلِهِ وَ اَلْقُبْلَةُ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Touching the deceased at the time of death, after the washing (ghusl), and kissing them - there is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 455
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 119

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from Fadalah, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) kissed 'Uthman ibn Maz'un after his death."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَبَّلَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ مَظْعُونٍ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from Fadalah, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) kissed 'Uthman ibn Maz'un after his death."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 455
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ali ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Al-Salt, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in touching the deceased after the washing (ghusl) and kissing him."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَمَسَّهُ بَعْدَ اَلْغُسْلِ وَ يُقَبِّلَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ali ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Al-Salt, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in touching the deceased after the washing (ghusl) and kissing him."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "The one who washes the deceased must perform ghusl, and everyone who touches a deceased person must also perform ghusl, even if the deceased has already been washed."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يَغْتَسِلُ اَلَّذِي غَسَّلَ اَلْمَيِّتَ وَ كُلُّ مَنْ مَسَّ مَيِّتاً فَعَلَيْهِ اَلْغُسْلُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ اَلْمَيِّتُ قَدْ غُسِّلَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The one who washes the deceased must perform ghusl, and everyone who touches a deceased person must also perform ghusl, even if the deceased has already been washed."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Al-‘Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked regarding a man who touches a dead animal, is ghusl required for him? Imam (a.s) said: "No, that (requirement) applies only to (the dead body of) a human being."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ مَسَّ مَيْتَةً أَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْغُسْلُ قَالَ« لاَ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ اَلْإِنْسَانِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Al-‘Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding a man who touches a dead animal, is ghusl required for him? Imam (a.s) said: "No, that (requirement) applies only to (the dead body of) a human being."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi:
I asked Abu ‘Abdillah (a.s), about a man who touches a dead animal. Is it necessary for him to perform ghusl because of it? Imam (a.s) said: “No, that requirement applies only to a human being.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمَسُّ اَلْمَيْتَةَ أَ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ« لاَ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ اَلْإِنْسَانِ وَحْدَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu ‘Abdillah (a.s), about a man who touches a dead animal. Is it necessary for him to perform ghusl because of it? Imam (a.s) said: “No, that requirement applies only to a human being.”

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Ali ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Al-Salt, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim Al-Rizzami narrated from Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s), from his father Imam Al Baqir (a.s):
Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The person most entitled to wash the deceased is the one closest to him.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي غِيَاثُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلرِّزَامِيُّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« يُغَسِّلُ اَلْمَيِّتَ أَوْلَى اَلنَّاسِ بِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Ali ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Al-Salt, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim Al-Rizzami narrated from Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s), from his father Imam Al Baqir (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The person most entitled to wash the deceased is the one closest to him.”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar said:
I wrote to Abu Muhammad, (Imam Hasan Al-Askari (a.s)) asking: “What is the prescribed amount of water used for washing the deceased, as it has been narrated that the junub (one in a state of ritual impurity) washes with six ratls, and the menstruating woman washes with nine ratls? Is there a specific amount of water prescribed for washing the deceased?” Imam (a.s) replied: “The washing of the deceased should continue until it becomes clean, if Allah (swt), the Exalted, wills.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَمْ حَدُّ اَلْمَاءِ اَلَّذِي يُغَسَّلُ بِهِ اَلْمَيِّتُ كَمَا رَوَوْا «أَنَّ اَلْجُنُبَ يَغْتَسِلُ بِسِتَّةِ أَرْطَالٍ وَ اَلْحَائِضَ بِتِسْعَةِ أَرْطَالٍ» فَهَلْ لِلْمَيِّتِ حَدٌّ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ اَلَّذِي يُغَسَّلُ بِهِ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« حَدُّ غُسْلِ اَلْمَيِّتِ يُغَسَّلُ حَتَّى يَطْهُرَ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu Muhammad, (Imam Hasan Al-Askari (a.s)) asking: “What is the prescribed amount of water used for washing the deceased, as it has been narrated that the junub (one in a state of ritual impurity) washes with six ratls, and the menstruating woman washes with nine ratls? Is there a specific amount of water prescribed for washing the deceased?” Imam (a.s) replied: “The washing of the deceased should continue until it becomes clean, if Allah (swt), the Exalted, wills.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 456
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 120

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: He (Narrator) said: “I wrote to Abu Muhammad, (Imam Hasan Al-Askari (a.s)) asking: Is it permissible for the water used to wash the deceased to flow into a well of a latrine?” Imam (a.s) replied: “It should flow into drains.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُغَسَّلَ اَلْمَيِّتُ وَ مَاؤُهُ اَلَّذِي يُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِ يَدْخُلُ إِلَى بِئْرِ كَنِيفٍ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ فِي بَلاَلِيعَ».
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “I wrote to Abu Muhammad, (Imam Hasan Al-Askari (a.s)) asking: Is it permissible for the water used to wash the deceased to flow into a well of a latrine?” Imam (a.s) replied: “It should flow into drains.”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 120

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa, from Musa bin al-Qasim al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah, from Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Imam Musa Al-Kadhim (a.s), said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about washing the deceased in an open space. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, but if he is roofed (under cover) with a curtain, it is more preferable to me.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَيِّتِ يُغَسَّلُ فِي اَلْفَضَاءِ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ سُتِرَ بِسِتْرٍ فَهُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa, from Musa bin al-Qasim al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah, from Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Imam Musa Al-Kadhim (a.s), said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about washing the deceased in an open space. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, but if he is roofed (under cover) with a curtain, it is more preferable to me.”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Hasan bin Mahbub, from Ibrahim bin Mihzam, from Talhah bin Zaid, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
The father (Imam Al Baqir (a.s)) of Him (Imam Al Sadiq (a.s)) used to prefer that a cover be placed between the deceased and the sky, meaning when the deceased is being washed.
arabicText: اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مِهْزَمٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ أَبَاهُ كَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ بَيْنَ اَلْمَيِّتِ وَ بَيْنَ اَلسَّمَاءِ سِتْرٌ» يَعْنِي إِذَا غُسِّلَ.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Hasan bin Mahbub, from Ibrahim bin Mihzam, from Talhah bin Zaid, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: The father (Imam Al Baqir (a.s)) of Him (Imam Al Sadiq (a.s)) used to prefer that a cover be placed between the deceased and the sky, meaning when the deceased is being washed.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 457
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali bin Muhammad al-Qasani, from Mansur bin Abbas and Ahmad bin Zakariya, from Muhammad bin Ali bin Isa, said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (the First) (a.s), about a dry palm leaf if it is broken by hand - can it be placed with the deceased in his grave? Imam (a.s) replied: "The dry one is not permissible."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْقَاسَانِيُّ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلسَّعَفَةِ اَلْيَابِسَةِ إِذَا قَطَعَهَا بِيَدِهِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لِلْمَيِّتِ تُوضَعُ مَعَهُ فِي حُفْرَتِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ يَجُوزُ اَلْيَابِسُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali bin Muhammad al-Qasani, from Mansur bin Abbas and Ahmad bin Zakariya, from Muhammad bin Ali bin Isa, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (the First) (a.s), about a dry palm leaf if it is broken by hand - can it be placed with the deceased in his grave? Imam (a.s) replied: "The dry one is not permissible."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 457
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin al-Hasan bin Ali bin Faddal, from Amr bin Saeed, from Musaddiq bin Sadaqa, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked about a woman who dies during childbirth - how should she be washed? Imam (a.s) replied: "Like the washing of a purified woman. Likewise, a menstruating woman and a person in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) are washed with only one washing."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا مَاتَتْ فِي نِفَاسِهَا كَيْفَ تُغَسَّلُ قَالَ« مِثْلَ غُسْلِ اَلطَّاهِرِ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْحَائِضُ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْجُنُبُ إِنَّمَا يُغَسَّلُ غُسْلاً وَاحِداً فَقَطْ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin al-Hasan bin Ali bin Faddal, from Amr bin Saeed, from Musaddiq bin Sadaqa, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about a woman who dies during childbirth - how should she be washed? Imam (a.s) replied: "Like the washing of a purified woman. Likewise, a menstruating woman and a person in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) are washed with only one washing."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 457
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Al-Husayn bin Sa'id, from Ali, from Imam Abu Ibrahim (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about a deceased person who dies while in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah). Imam (a.s) said: "One washing (ghusl e mayyat) is sufficient."
arabicText: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَيِّتِ يَمُوتُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ« غُسْلٌ وَاحِدٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Al-Husayn bin Sa'id, from Ali, from Imam Abu Ibrahim (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a deceased person who dies while in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah). Imam (a.s) said: "One washing (ghusl e mayyat) is sufficient."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Ali bin Hadid and Abd al-Rahman, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurara:
I said to Abu Ja'far (a.s): "A deceased person who died while in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) - how is he washed, and what amount of water suffices for him?" Imam (a.s) said: "He is washed with a single ghusl, and that suffices both for janabah and for the washing of the deceased, because two obligations have combined in one obligation."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ وَ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَيِّتٌ مَاتَ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ كَيْفَ يُغَسَّلُ وَ مَا يُجْزِيهِ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ قَالَ« يُغَسَّلُ غُسْلاً وَاحِداً يُجْزِي ذَلِكَ لِلْجَنَابَةِ وَ لِغُسْلِ اَلْمَيِّتِ لِأَنَّهُمَا حُرْمَتَانِ اِجْتَمَعَتَا فِي حُرْمَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Ali bin Hadid and Abd al-Rahman, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurara:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja'far (a.s): "A deceased person who died while in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) - how is he washed, and what amount of water suffices for him?" Imam (a.s) said: "He is washed with a single ghusl, and that suffices both for janabah and for the washing of the deceased, because two obligations have combined in one obligation."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 458
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 120

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali bin Mahziyar, from al-Husayn bin Sa'id, from Ali bin al-Nu'man, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Muthanna, from Abu Basir, from one of the Imams (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked regarding a person in a state of janabah who dies. Imam (a.s) said: "He only requires a single ghusl."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْمُثَنَّى عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلْجُنُبِ إِذَا مَاتَ قَالَ« لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ غَسْلَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali bin Mahziyar, from al-Husayn bin Sa'id, from Ali bin al-Nu'man, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Muthanna, from Abu Basir, from one of the Imams (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding a person in a state of janabah who dies. Imam (a.s) said: "He only requires a single ghusl."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 458
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 120

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibrahim bin Hashim, from al-Husayn bin Sa'id, from Safwan bin Yahya, from 'Iys, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who died while in a state of janabah. Imam (a.s) said: "He is washed once with water, and then he is washed again after that."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ« يُغْسَلُ غَسْلَةً وَاحِدَةً بِمَاءٍ ثُمَّ يُغَسَّلُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ibrahim bin Hashim, from al-Husayn bin Sa'id, from Safwan bin Yahya, from 'Iys, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who died while in a state of janabah. Imam (a.s) said: "He is washed once with water, and then he is washed again after that."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali bin Muhammad narrated from Abu al-Qasim Sa'id bin Muhammad al-Kufi, from Muhammad bin Abi Hamzah, from 'Iys:
I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "A man dies while in a state of janabah." Imam (a.s) said: "He is washed for janabah, and then he is washed afterward with the washing of the deceased."
arabicText: وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْقَاسِمِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْكُوفِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عِيصٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَمُوتُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ« يُغْسَلُ مِنَ اَلْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ يُغَسَّلُ بَعْدُ غُسْلَ اَلْمَيِّتِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali bin Muhammad narrated from Abu al-Qasim Sa'id bin Muhammad al-Kufi, from Muhammad bin Abi Hamzah, from 'Iys:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "A man dies while in a state of janabah." Imam (a.s) said: "He is washed for janabah, and then he is washed afterward with the washing of the deceased."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 458
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
He (narrated) from Muhammad bin Khalid, from Abdullah bin al-Mughira, who said: Some of our companions informed me, from 'Iys, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), from his father (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "When the deceased dies, proceed with preparing him and hasten (the burial). And if the deceased dies while in a state of janabah, he is washed with one washing, and then he is washed afterward."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ عِيصٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا مَاتَ اَلْمَيِّتُ فَخُذْ فِي جَهَازِهِ وَ عَجِّلْهُ وَ إِذَا مَاتَ اَلْمَيِّتُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ غُسِلَ غَسْلاً وَاحِداً ثُمَّ يُغَسَّلُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ».
thaqalaynSanad: He (narrated) from Muhammad bin Khalid, from Abdullah bin al-Mughira, who said: Some of our companions informed me, from 'Iys, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), from his father (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "When the deceased dies, proceed with preparing him and hasten (the burial). And if the deceased dies while in a state of janabah, he is washed with one washing, and then he is washed afterward."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 458
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali bin Al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Ali, from Abdullah bin Al-Salt, from Abdullah bin Al-Mughira, from 'Iys bin Al-Qasim, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If the deceased dies while in a state of janabah, he is washed with one washing, and then he is washed again afterward."
arabicText: رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا مَاتَ اَلْمَيِّتُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ غُسِّلَ غُسْلاً وَاحِداً ثُمَّ اِغْتَسَلَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali bin Al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Ali, from Abdullah bin Al-Salt, from Abdullah bin Al-Mughira, from 'Iys bin Al-Qasim, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If the deceased dies while in a state of janabah, he is washed with one washing, and then he is washed again afterward."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 459
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl bin Ziyad narrated from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Abi Jameelah, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Prophet, may Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: "There is nothing better among your clothing than white, so wear it and shroud your dead in it."
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« لَيْسَ مِنْ لِبَاسِكُمْ شَيْءٌ أَحْسَنَ مِنَ اَلْبَيَاضِ فَالْبَسُوهُ وَ كَفِّنُوا فِيهِ مَوْتَاكُمْ».
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl bin Ziyad narrated from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Abi Jameelah, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Prophet, may Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: "There is nothing better among your clothing than white, so wear it and shroud your dead in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 459
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari narrated from some of our companions, from Ibn Fadhal, from Marwan, from Abdul Malik, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about a man who bought something from the covering of the Kaaba (kiswa). He used (sold) part of it to fulfill a need, and some of it remained in his possession. I asked: "Is it permissible to sell it?" Imam (a.s) replied: "He may sell what he wants, gift what he does not need, benefit from it, and seek its blessings." I then asked: "Can it (kiswa) be used to shroud the dead?" Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: أَبُو عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيُّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ اِشْتَرَى مِنْ كِسْوَةِ اَلْكَعْبَةِ شَيْئاً فَقَضَى بِبَعْضِهِ حَاجَتَهُ وَ بَقِيَ بَعْضُهُ فِي يَدِهِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ بَيْعُهُ قَالَ« يَبِيعُ مَا أَرَادَ وَ يَهَبُ مَا لَمْ يُرِدْ وَ يَسْتَنْفِعُ بِهِ وَ يَطْلُبُ بَرَكَتَهُ» قُلْتُ أَ يُكَفِّنُ بِهِ اَلْمَيِّتَ قَالَ« لاَ
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari narrated from some of our companions, from Ibn Fadhal, from Marwan, from Abdul Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about a man who bought something from the covering of the Kaaba (kiswa). He used (sold) part of it to fulfill a need, and some of it remained in his possession. I asked: "Is it permissible to sell it?" Imam (a.s) replied: "He may sell what he wants, gift what he does not need, benefit from it, and seek its blessings." I then asked: "Can it (kiswa) be used to shroud the dead?" Imam (a.s) said: "No."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 459
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Yahya narrated from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn, from Abdul Rahman bin Abi Hashim, from Abu Khadijah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Linen was used by the Children of Israel for shrouding their dead, and cotton is for the nation of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon him and his family."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْكَتَّانُ كَانَ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ يُكَفَّنُونَ بِهِ وَ اَلْقُطْنُ لِأُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Yahya narrated from Muhammad bin Al-Husayn, from Abdul Rahman bin Abi Hashim, from Abu Khadijah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Linen was used by the Children of Israel for shrouding their dead, and cotton is for the nation of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon him and his family."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 459
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa'id from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (the First) (a.s), who said:
I heard Imam (a.s) say: “I shrouded my father (Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s)) in two garments from Shatawiyyah, in which he used to wear the ihram, and in a shirt from his shirts, and in a turban that belonged to (Imam) Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), and in a cloak which I purchased for forty dinars. If it were (purchased) today, it would have been worth four hundred dinars.
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:« أَنَا كَفَّنْتُ أَبِي فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ شَطَوِيَّيْنِ كَانَ يُحْرِمُ فِيهِمَا وَ فِي قَمِيصٍ مِنْ قُمُصِهِ وَ فِي عِمَامَةٍ كَانَتْ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ فِي بُرْدٍ اِشْتَرَيْتُهُ بِأَرْبَعِينَ دِينَاراً لَوْ كَانَ اَلْيَوْمَ لَسَاوَى أَرْبَعَمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ».
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa'id from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (the First) (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) say: “I shrouded my father (Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s)) in two garments from Shatawiyyah, in which he used to wear the ihram, and in a shirt from his shirts, and in a turban that belonged to (Imam) Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), and in a cloak which I purchased for forty dinars. If it were (purchased) today, it would have been worth four hundred dinars.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 460
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from some of his companions, from al-Washsha', from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The deceased should not be shrouded in black.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُكَفَّنُ اَلْمَيِّتُ فِي اَلسَّوَادِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from some of his companions, from al-Washsha', from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The deceased should not be shrouded in black.”

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha', from Ahmad ibn 'A'id, from al-Husayn ibn Mukhtar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s): “Can a man enter the state of ihram in a black garment?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should not enter ihram in a black garment, nor should he be shrouded in it.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُخْتَارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُحْرِمُ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي ثَوْبٍ أَسْوَدَ قَالَ« لاَ يُحْرِمُ فِي اَلثَّوْبِ اَلْأَسْوَدِ وَ لاَ يُكَفَّنُ بِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha', from Ahmad ibn 'A'id, from al-Husayn ibn Mukhtar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s): “Can a man enter the state of ihram in a black garment?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should not enter ihram in a black garment, nor should he be shrouded in it.”

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about garments made in Basra, woven in the style of Yemeni striped fabric, made of silk and cotton. Is it permissible to shroud the dead in them? Imam (a.s) said: “If the cotton is more than the silk, then there is no problem.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ثِيَابٍ تُعْمَلُ بِالْبَصْرَةِ عَلَى عَمَلِ اَلْعَصْبِ اَلْيَمَانِيِّ مِنْ قَزٍّ وَ قُطْنٍ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يُكَفَّنَ فِيهِ اَلْمَوْتَى قَالَ« إِذَا كَانَ اَلْقُطْنُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ اَلْقَزِّ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about garments made in Basra, woven in the style of Yemeni striped fabric, made of silk and cotton. Is it permissible to shroud the dead in them? Imam (a.s) said: “If the cotton is more than the silk, then there is no problem.”

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Fudayl Sukkarah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "May I be your ransom, is there a specific amount of water required for washing (of the deceased)?" Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), said to (Imam) Ali (a.s): 'When I die, bring six water skins filled with water from the well of Ghars, and wash me and shroud me. After you have completed my washing and shrouding, then take hold of the edges of my shroud, sit me up, and ask me whatever you wish. By Allah (swt), you will not ask me about anything except that I will answer you regarding it.'"
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ سُكَّرَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ هَلْ لِلْمَاءِ حَدٌّ مَحْدُودٌ قَالَ« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِذَا أَنَامِتُّ فَاسْتَقِ لِي سِتَّ قِرَبٍ مِنْ مَاءِ بِئْرِ غَرْسٍ وَ غَسِّلْنِي وَ كَفِّنِّي فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْ غُسْلِي وَ كَفْنِي فَخُذْ بِمَجَامِعِ كَفَنِي وَ أَجْلِسْنِي ثُمَّ سَلْنِي عَمَّا شِئْتَ فَوَ اَللَّهِ لاَ تَسْأَلُنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ أَجَبْتُكَ فِيهِ»».
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Fudayl Sukkarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "May I be your ransom, is there a specific amount of water required for washing (of the deceased)?" Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), said to (Imam) Ali (a.s): 'When I die, bring six water skins filled with water from the well of Ghars, and wash me and shroud me. After you have completed my washing and shrouding, then take hold of the edges of my shroud, sit me up, and ask me whatever you wish. By Allah (swt), you will not ask me about anything except that I will answer you regarding it.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 460
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn Al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said to (Imam) Ali (a.s): "O Ali (a.s), when I die, wash me with seven water skins filled with water from the well of Ghars."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِعَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« يَا عَلِيُّ إِذَا أَنَامِتُّ فَاغْسِلْنِي بِسَبْعِ قِرَبٍ مِنْ مَاءِ بِئْرِ غَرْسٍ»».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn Al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said to (Imam) Ali (a.s): "O Ali (a.s), when I die, wash me with seven water skins filled with water from the well of Ghars."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 461
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "When you shroud the deceased, sprinkle some powdered perfume and camphor on each piece of the shroud. Place some of the hanoot (a mixture of perfumes) on his ears, his places of prostration, and some on the back of the shroud."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ:« إِذَا كَفَّنْتَ اَلْمَيِّتَ فَذُرَّ عَلَى كُلِّ ثَوْبٍ شَيْئاً مِنْ ذَرِيرَةٍ وَ كَافُورٍ وَ تَجْعَلُ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْحَنُوطِ عَلَى مَسَامِعِهِ وَ مَسَاجِدِهِ وَ شَيْئاً عَلَى ظَهْرِ اَلْكَفَنِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "When you shroud the deceased, sprinkle some powdered perfume and camphor on each piece of the shroud. Place some of the hanoot (a mixture of perfumes) on his ears, his places of prostration, and some on the back of the shroud."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 461
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "The cloak is not to be wrapped around (the deceased), but rather it should be placed over him as a covering. And when he is placed in the grave, it should be positioned under his cheek and under his side."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْبُرْدُ لاَ يُلَفُّ وَ لَكِنْ يُطْرَحُ عَلَيْهِ طَرْحاً وَ إِذَا أُدْخِلَ اَلْقَبْرَ وُضِعَ تَحْتَ خَدِّهِ وَ تَحْتَ جَنْبِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The cloak is not to be wrapped around (the deceased), but rather it should be placed over him as a covering. And when he is placed in the grave, it should be positioned under his cheek and under his side."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 461
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Malik al-Juhani, from al-Husayn ibn Umara, from Abu Ja'far (a.s).
He (Narrator) said: “I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who purchased something from the coverings of the Ka'bah - can he shroud a deceased person with it?” Imam (a.s) replied: "No."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ اَلْجُهَنِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ اِشْتَرَى مِنْ كِسْوَةِ اَلْبَيْتِ شَيْئاً هَلْ يُكَفِّنُ بِهِ اَلْمَيِّتَ قَالَ« لاَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Malik al-Juhani, from al-Husayn ibn Umara, from Abu Ja'far (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who purchased something from the coverings of the Ka'bah - can he shroud a deceased person with it?” Imam (a.s) replied: "No."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 461
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdul Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi.
He (Narrator) said: “I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), about a man who purchased something from the coverings of the Ka'bah - can he shroud a deceased person with it?” Imam (a.s) replied: "No."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ اِشْتَرَى مِنْ كِسْوَةِ اَلْبَيْتِ شَيْئاً هَلْ يُكَفِّنُ فِيهِ اَلْمَيِّتَ قَالَ« لاَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdul Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi.
thaqalaynMatn: He (Narrator) said: “I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), about a man who purchased something from the coverings of the Ka'bah - can he shroud a deceased person with it?” Imam (a.s) replied: "No."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Abi Umair, from Hammad, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (a.s).
The Imams (a.s) said: "When you have dried the deceased, take the camphor and wipe it on the marks of prostration and all the joints. Place some of the hanoot in his mouth, ears, head, and beard, and also on his chest and private area." They (a.s) also said: "The hanoot for a man and a woman is the same."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:« إِذَا جَفَّفْتَ اَلْمَيِّتَ عَمَدْتَ إِلَى اَلْكَافُورِ فَمَسَحْتَ بِهِ آثَارَ اَلسُّجُودِ وَ مَفَاصِلَهُ كُلَّهَا وَ اِجْعَلْ فِي فِيهِ وَ مَسَامِعِهِ وَ رَأْسِهِ وَ لِحْيَتِهِ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْحَنُوطِ وَ عَلَى صَدْرِهِ وَ فَرْجِهِ» وَ قَالَ« حَنُوطُ اَلرَّجُلِ وَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ سَوَاءٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Abi Umair, from Hammad, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: The Imams (a.s) said: "When you have dried the deceased, take the camphor and wipe it on the marks of prostration and all the joints. Place some of the hanoot in his mouth, ears, head, and beard, and also on his chest and private area." They (a.s) also said: "The hanoot for a man and a woman is the same."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Dawood ibn Sirhan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said regarding the shroud of Abu Ubaydah al-Hadhdha’: "Indeed, the hanoot is camphor. However, go and do as the people customarily do."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ سِرْحَانَ قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كَفْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ اَلْحَذَّاءِ:« إِنَّمَا اَلْحَنُوطُ اَلْكَافُورُ وَ لَكِنِ اِذْهَبْ فَاصْنَعْ كَمَا يَصْنَعُ اَلنَّاسُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Dawood ibn Sirhan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said regarding the shroud of Abu Ubaydah al-Hadhdha’: "Indeed, the hanoot is camphor. However, go and do as the people customarily do."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 462
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Kahili, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If blood or any other substance comes out of the nose of the deceased after being washed and it touches the turban or the shroud, it should be cut off from it."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْكَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ مَنْخِرِ اَلْمَيِّتِ اَلدَّمُ أَوِ اَلشَّيْءُ بَعْدَمَا يُغَسَّلُ فَأَصَابَ اَلْعِمَامَةَ وَ اَلْكَفَنَ قُرِضَ مِنْهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Kahili, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If blood or any other substance comes out of the nose of the deceased after being washed and it touches the turban or the shroud, it should be cut off from it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 462
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s):
Imam Ali (a.s) said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "The best shroud is the garment, and the best sacrifice is the horned ram."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« نِعْمَ اَلْكَفَنُ اَلْحُلَّةُ وَ نِعْمَ اَلْأُضْحِيَّةُ اَلْكَبْشُ اَلْأَقْرَنُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Imam Ja’far Al Sadiq (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s) said that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "The best shroud is the garment, and the best sacrifice is the horned ram."

Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "The cost of the shroud is to be taken from the entirety of the wealth."
arabicText: اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« ثَمَنُ اَلْكَفَنِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ اَلْمَالِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The cost of the shroud is to be taken from the entirety of the wealth."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 462
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali narrated from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakooni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "The Prophet, may Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, prohibited placing hanoot (perfumed substances) on the bier."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ نَهَى أَنْ يُوضَعُ عَلَى اَلنَّعْشِ اَلْحَنُوطُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali narrated from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakooni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The Prophet, may Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, prohibited placing hanoot (perfumed substances) on the bier."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 463
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Zurara:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked regarding a man who dies and only women are present. Imam (a.s) said: "His wife may wash his body because she is in his waiting period (iddah) with him. However, if she dies, he may not wash her body because he is not in her waiting period."
arabicText: عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ نِسَاءٌ قَالَ« تُغَسِّلُهُ اِمْرَأَتُهُ لِأَنَّهَا مِنْهُ فِي عِدَّةٍ وَإِذَا مَاتَتْ لَمْ يُغَسِّلْهَا لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْهَا فِي عِدَّةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Zurara:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked regarding a man who dies and only women are present. Imam (a.s) said: "His wife may wash his body because she is in his waiting period (iddah) with him. However, if she dies, he may not wash her body because he is not in her waiting period."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 463
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi: Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked about a man who dies and there is no one to wash his body except women. Imam (a.s) said: "His wife or a close female relative, if he has one, may wash his body, and the women should pour water over him." (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a woman who dies (if she dies and there is no other woman present to wash her). Imam (a.s) said: "Her husband may insert his hand under her shirt and wash her body."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ مَنْ يُغَسِّلُهُ إِلاَّ اَلنِّسَاءُ قَالَ« تُغَسِّلُهُ اِمْرَأَتُهُ أَوْ ذَاتُ قَرَابَتِهِ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ وَ تَصُبُّ اَلنِّسَاءُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْمَاءَ صَبّاً وَ فِي اَلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا مَاتَتْ يُدْخِلُ زَوْجُهَا يَدَهُ تَحْتَ قَمِيصِهَا فَيُغَسِّلُهَا».
thaqalaynMatn: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi: Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked about a man who dies and there is no one to wash his body except women. Imam (a.s) said: "His wife or a close female relative, if he has one, may wash his body, and the women should pour water over him." (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a woman who dies (if she dies and there is no other woman present to wash her). Imam (a.s) said: "Her husband may insert his hand under her shirt and wash her body."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 463
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man washing his wife’s body (if she dies and there is no other woman present to wash her). Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, from behind the clothes."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغَسِّلُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ اَلثِّيَابِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man washing his wife’s body (if she dies and there is no other woman present to wash her). Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, from behind the clothes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 463
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 121

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman if she died (if she dies and there is no other woman present to wash her). Imam (a.s) said: "Her husband may insert his hand under her shirt up to the elbows and wash her."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا مَاتَتْ فَقَالَ «يُدْخِلُ زَوْجُهَا يَدَهُ تَحْتَ قَمِيصِهَا إِلَى اَلْمَرَافِقِ فَيُغَسِّلُهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Sama'ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman if she died (if she dies and there is no other woman present to wash her). Imam (a.s) said: "Her husband may insert his hand under her shirt up to the elbows and wash her."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 463
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 122

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked regarding a woman who dies and there is no other woman present to wash her. Imam (a.s) said: "Her husband may insert his hand under her shirt and wash her up to the elbows."
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا مَاتَتْ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا اِمْرَأَةٌ تُغَسِّلُهَا قَالَ« يُدْخِلُ زَوْجُهَا يَدَهُ تَحْتَ قَمِيصِهَا فَيُغَسِّلُهَا إِلَى اَلْمَرَافِقِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked regarding a woman who dies and there is no other woman present to wash her. Imam (a.s) said: "Her husband may insert his hand under her shirt and wash her up to the elbows."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 464
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (a.s).
Imam (a.s) said regarding a man who dies during a journey in a land where there are only women present: "He is to be buried without being washed. Similarly, if a woman is among men in that situation, she is to be buried without being washed - unless her husband is present with her. If her husband is present, he may wash her from above her garment by pouring water over her without looking at her private parts. Likewise, a woman may wash her husband if he dies. However, a woman is not in the same position as men. The appearance of a woman is more difficult to handle when she dies."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فِي أَرْضٍ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ اَلنِّسَاءُ قَالَ« يُدْفَنُ وَ لاَ يُغَسَّلُ وَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ تَكُونُ مَعَ اَلرِّجَالِ بِتِلْكَ اَلْمَنْزِلَةِ تُدْفَنُ وَلاَ تُغَسَّلُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ زَوْجُهَا مَعَهَا فَإِنْ كَانَ زَوْجُهَا مَعَهَا غَسَّلَهَا مِنْ فَوْقِ اَلدِّرْعِ وَ يَسْكُبُ اَلْمَاءَ عَلَيْهَا سَكْباً وَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى عَوْرَتِهَا وَ تُغَسِّلُهُ اِمْرَأَتُهُ إِنْ مَاتَ وَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ لَيْسَتْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ اَلرِّجَالِ اَلْمَرْأَةُ أَسْوَأُ مَنْظَراً إِذَا مَاتَتْ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (a.s).
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said regarding a man who dies during a journey in a land where there are only women present: "He is to be buried without being washed. Similarly, if a woman is among men in that situation, she is to be buried without being washed - unless her husband is present with her. If her husband is present, he may wash her from above her garment by pouring water over her without looking at her private parts. Likewise, a woman may wash her husband if he dies. However, a woman is not in the same position as men. The appearance of a woman is more difficult to handle when she dies."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 464
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 122

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), a narration similar to the previous one (H.1414).
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ سِرْحَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَهُ.
thaqalaynMatn: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), a narration similar to the previous one (H.1414).

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 464
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Humayd ibn Ziyad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Kindi, from more than one source, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who dies and has no one to wash him except women. Should the women wash him? Imam (a.s) said: "His wife or a woman who is a close relative (mahram) should wash him, and the women should pour water over him from above the garments."
arabicText: حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْكِنْدِيِّ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ مَنْ يُغَسِّلُهُ إِلاَّ اَلنِّسَاءُ هَلْ تُغَسِّلُهُ اَلنِّسَاءُ فَقَالَ «تُغَسِّلُهُ اِمْرَأَتُهُ أَوْ ذَاتُ مَحْرَمِهِ وَ تَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ اَلنِّسَاءُ اَلْمَاءَ صَبّاً مِنْ فَوْقِ اَلثِّيَابِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Humayd ibn Ziyad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Kindi, from more than one source, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who dies and has no one to wash him except women. Should the women wash him? Imam (a.s) said: "His wife or a woman who is a close relative (mahram) should wash him, and the women should pour water over him from above the garments."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 1, p. 464
Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tahdhīb, p. 122

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s), whether a man is permitted to look at his wife when she dies and to wash her if there is no one else available to wash her. I also asked whether a woman is allowed to look at her husband in a similar situation when he dies. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no problem with that. However, it is usually the woman's family who prevent her husband from looking at something they find unpleasant."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ أَ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى اِمْرَأَتِهِ حِينَ تَمُوتُ وَ يُغَسِّلَهَا إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ مَنْ يُغَسِّلُهَا وَ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ هَلْ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ مِنْ زَوْجِهَا حِينَ يَمُوتُ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَهْلُ اَلْمَرْأَةِ كَرَاهَةَ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ زَوْجُهَا إِلَى شَيْءٍ يَكْرَهُونَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s), whether a man is permitted to look at his wife when she dies and to wash her if there is no one else available to wash her. I also asked whether a woman is allowed to look at her husband in a similar situation when he dies. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no problem with that. However, it is usually the woman's family who prevent her husband from looking at something they find unpleasant."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari narrated from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Mansur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s), about a man who sets out on a journey with his wife, and she dies. Can he wash her? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and also (he can wash) his mother, his sister, and those similar (in relation) to them. He should place a cloth over the private parts."
arabicText: أَبُو عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ مَعَهُ اِمْرَأَتُهُ فَتَمُوتُ يُغَسِّلُهَا قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ أُمَّهُ وَ أُخْتَهُ وَ نَحْوَ هَذَا يُلْقِي عَلَى عَوْرَتِهَا خِرْقَةً».
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari narrated from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Mansur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s), about a man who sets out on a journey with his wife, and she dies. Can he wash her? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and also (he can wash) his mother, his sister, and those similar (in relation) to them. He should place a cloth over the private parts."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali narrated from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man washing his wife. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes (it is allowed), (it is) only her family prevents it out of prejudice."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغَسِّلُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا يَمْنَعُهَا أَهْلُهَا تَعَصُّباً».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali narrated from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man washing his wife. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes (it is allowed), (it is) only her family prevents it out of prejudice."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from Ali, from Abu Basir, said:
Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "A husband may wash his wife (who dies) during travel, and a wife may wash her husband (who dies) during travel, if there is no other with them."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« يُغَسِّلُ اَلزَّوْجُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ زَوْجَهَا فِي اَلسَّفَرِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ رَجُلٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from Ali, from Abu Basir, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdullah (a.s) said: "A husband may wash his wife (who dies) during travel, and a wife may wash her husband (who dies) during travel, if there is no other with them."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid, from Abu Hamzah:
Abu Ja'far (a.s) said: "A man should not wash a woman unless no other woman is available."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُغَسِّلُ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلْمَرْأَةَ إِلاَّ أَنْ لاَ تُوجَدَ اِمْرَأَةٌ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid, from Abu Hamzah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far (a.s) said: "A man should not wash a woman unless no other woman is available."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Salim, from Mufaddal ibn Umar:
I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "May I be your ransom, who washed (Sayyida) Fatimah (s.a) ?" Imam (a.s) said: "It was Commander of the Faithful (a.s) (who washed her)." I (the Narrator) reacted as if I found this statement surprising, so Imam (a.s) said: "It seems you are uncomfortable with what I have told you." I asked: "Was that really the case? May I be your ransom?" Imam (a.s) said: "Do not feel uneasy, for She (s.a) was a Siddiqah (truthful one), and only a Siddiq (truthful one) could have washed her. Do you not know that Maryam (s.a), peace be upon her, was only washed by Isa (a.s)?" I asked: "May I be your ransom, what do you say about a woman who is in a journey with men, none of whom is her Mahram, and there is no woman with them, and she dies - what should be done with her?" Imam (a.s) said: "The parts of her body that Allah (swt) has required to be purified through Tayammum should be washed. She should not be touched, nor should any part of her body that Allah (swt) commanded to be covered be uncovered." I asked: "How should this be done?" Imam (a.s) said: "The palms of her hands and her face should be washed."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ مَنْ غَسَّلَ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ« ذَاكَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» قَالَ فَكَأَنِّي اِسْتَعْظَمْتُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ قَالَ« فَكَأَنَّكَ ضِقْتَ بِمَا أَخْبَرْتُكَ بِهِ» قُلْتُ فَقَدْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَالَ« لاَ تَضِيقَنَّ فَإِنَّهَا صِدِّيقَةٌ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُغَسِّلُهَا إِلاَّ صِدِّيقٌ أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ لَمْ يُغَسِّلْهَا إِلاَّ عِيسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فَمَا تَقُولُ فِي اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَكُونُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مَعَ اَلرِّجَالِ لَيْسَ فِيهِمْ لَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ وَ لاَ مَعَهُمُ اِمْرَأَةٌ فَتَمُوتُ اَلْمَرْأَةُ مَا يُصْنَعُ بِهَا قَالَ« يُغْسَلُ مِنْهَا مَا أَوْجَبَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا اَلتَّيَمُّمَ وَ لاَ تُمَسُّ وَ لاَ يُكْشَفُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ مَحَاسِنِهَا اَلَّتِي أَمَرَ اَللَّهُ بِسَتْرِهِ» فَقُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهَا قَالَ« يُغْسَلُ بَطْنُ كَفَّيْهَا ثُمَّ يُغْسَلُ وَجْهُهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Salim, from Mufaddal ibn Umar:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdullah (a.s): "May I be your ransom, who washed (Sayyida) Fatimah (s.a) ?" Imam (a.s) said: "It was Commander of the Faithful (a.s) (who washed her)." I (the Narrator) reacted as if I found this statement surprising, so Imam (a.s) said: "It seems you are uncomfortable with what I have told you." I asked: "Was that really the case? May I be your ransom?" Imam (a.s) said: "Do not feel uneasy, for She (s.a) was a Siddiqah (truthful one), and only a Siddiq (truthful one) could have washed her. Do you not know that Maryam (s.a), peace be upon her, was only washed by Isa (a.s)?" I asked: "May I be your ransom, what do you say about a woman who is in a journey with men, none of whom is her Mahram, and there is no woman with them, and she dies - what should be done with her?" Imam (a.s) said: "The parts of her body that Allah (swt) has required to be purified through Tayammum should be washed. She should not be touched, nor should any part of her body that Allah (swt) commanded to be covered be uncovered." I asked: "How should this be done?" Imam (a.s) said: "The palms of her hands and her face should be washed."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked about a man washing his wife. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, he may wash her from behind the garment, without looking at her hair or any part of her body. A woman may also wash her husband because, if he dies, she remains in his waiting period (iddah). However, if she dies, her waiting period is already completed." Imam (a.s) was also asked about a woman who dies while traveling, and there is no Mahram (male guardian) or other women with her. Imam (a.s) said: "She should be buried as she is, in her clothes." Imam (a.s) was further asked about a man who dies while traveling, and there is no Mahram or other men with him. Imam (a.s) said: "He should be buried as he is, in his clothes."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغَسِّلُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ اَلثَّوْبِ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى شَعْرِهَا وَ لاَ إِلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْهَا وَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ تُغَسِّلُ زَوْجَهَا لِأَنَّهُ إِذَا مَاتَ كَانَتْ فِي عِدَّةٍ مِنْهُ وَ إِذَا مَاتَتْ هِيَ فَقَدِ اِنْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا» وَ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ وَ لاَ نِسَاءٌ قَالَ« تُدْفَنُ كَمَاهِيَ بِثِيَابِهَا» وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ وَ لاَ رِجَالٌ قَالَ« يُدْفَنُ كَمَا هُوَ فِي ثِيَابِهِ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about a man washing his wife. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, he may wash her from behind the garment, without looking at her hair or any part of her body. A woman may also wash her husband because, if he dies, she remains in his waiting period (iddah). However, if she dies, her waiting period is already completed." Imam (a.s) was also asked about a woman who dies while traveling, and there is no Mahram (male guardian) or other women with her. Imam (a.s) said: "She should be buried as she is, in her clothes." Imam (a.s) was further asked about a man who dies while traveling, and there is no Mahram or other men with him. Imam (a.s) said: "He should be buried as he is, in his clothes."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated from him (the narrator) from Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri’ab, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about a man who dies while traveling with women and there is no man with them. How should they handle his burial? Imam (a.s) said: "They should wrap him completely in his clothes, bury him, and not wash him."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَمُوتُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مَعَ اَلنِّسَاءِ لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعْنَ بِهِ قَالَ« يَلْفُفْنَهُ لَفّاً فِي ثِيَابِهِ وَ يَدْفِنَّهُ وَ لاَ يُغَسِّلْنَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated from him (the narrator) from Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri’ab, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s) about a man who dies while traveling with women and there is no man with them. How should they handle his burial? Imam (a.s) said: "They should wrap him completely in his clothes, bury him, and not wash him."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Fadalah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah al-Basri, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman who dies among men (non mahram). Imam (a.s) said: "She should be wrapped and buried, and she should not be washed."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْبَصْرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ مَعَ رِجَالٍ قَالَ« تُلَفُّ وَ تُدْفَنُ وَ لاَ تُغَسَّلُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Fadalah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah al-Basri, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman who dies among men (non mahram). Imam (a.s) said: "She should be wrapped and buried, and she should not be washed."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa‘d ibn Abdillah narrated from Abu al-Jawza’, al-Munabbih ibn Abdillah, from al-Husayn ibn ‘Alwan, from ‘Amr ibn Khalid, from Zayd ibn ‘Ali, from his forefathers, from (Imam) ‘Ali (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If a man dies during a journey among women, and there is no wife or any woman from his mahrams among them, they should cover him up to the knees, pour water over him without looking at his private parts, and without touching him with their hands. They should purify him in this way. However, if he is accompanied by women who are his mahrams, they should cover him, pour water over him, and touch his body except for his private parts, which they should not touch."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَوْزَاءِ اَلْمُنَبِّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: إِذَا مَاتَ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ مَعَ اَلنِّسَاءِ لَيْسَ فِيهِنَّ اِمْرَأَتُهُ وَ لاَ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ قَالَ« يُؤَزِّرْنَهُ إِلَى اَلرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَ يَصْبُبْنَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْمَاءَ صَبّاً وَلاَ يَنْظُرْنَ إِلَى عَوْرَتِهِ وَلاَ يَلْمِسْنَهُ بِأَيْدِيهِنَّ وَ يُطَهِّرْنَهُ فَإِذَا كَانَ مَعَهُ نِسَاءٌ ذَوَاتُ مَحْرَمٍ يُؤَزِّرْنَهُ وَ يَصْبُبْنَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْمَاءَ صَبّاً وَ يَمْسَسْنَ جَسَدَهُ وَلاَ يَمْسَسْنَ فَرْجَهُ».
thaqalaynSanad: Sa‘d ibn Abdillah narrated from Abu al-Jawza’, al-Munabbih ibn Abdillah, from al-Husayn ibn ‘Alwan, from ‘Amr ibn Khalid, from Zayd ibn ‘Ali, from his forefathers, from (Imam) ‘Ali (a.s), who said:

They should purify him in this way. However, if he is accompanied by women who are his mahrams, they should cover him, pour water over him, and touch his body except for his private parts, which they should not touch."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from ‘Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir:
Abu Ja‘far (a.s) was asked regarding a man who died while accompanied only by women and there was no man with them. Imam (a.s) said: "They should pour water over him from behind a cloth, wrap him in his shroud under the cover, pray over him in a row, and then lower him into his grave." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a woman who dies among men with no woman present. Imam (a.s) said: "They should pour water over her from behind a cloth, wrap her in her shroud, pray over her, and then bury her."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ مَعَهُ نِسْوَةٌ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ قَالَ« يَصْبُبْنَ اَلْمَاءَ مِنْ خَلْفِ اَلثَّوْبِ وَ يَلْفُفْنَهُ فِي أَكْفَانِهِ مِنْ تَحْتِ اَلسِّتْرِ وَ يُصَلِّينَ صَفّاً وَ يُدْخِلْنَهُ قَبْرَهُ» وَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ مَعَ اَلرِّجَالِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ اِمْرَأَةٌ قَالَ« يَصُبُّونَ اَلْمَاءَ مِنْ خَلْفِ اَلثَّوْبِ وَ يَلُفُّونَهَا فِي أَكْفَانِهَا وَ يُصَلُّونَ وَ يَدْفِنُونَ».
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from ‘Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja‘far (a.s) was asked regarding a man who died while accompanied only by women and there was no man with them. Imam (a.s) said: "They should pour water over him from behind a cloth, wrap him in his shroud under the cover, pray over him in a row, and then lower him into his grave." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a woman who dies among men with no woman present. Imam (a.s) said: "They should pour water over her from behind a cloth, wrap her in her shroud, pray over her, and then bury her."

chapter: Chapter on Instructing the Dying (Talqin al-Muhtadarin)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from Dawud ibn Farqad, who said:
A companion of ours went to ask Abu ‘Abdillah (a.s), about a woman who dies among men, none of whom are her mahram (close male relatives). He asked whether they are permitted to wash her while she is in her clothes. Abu ‘Abdillah (a.s), replied: "If they were to do that, it would be exposing her (to improper handling). Instead, they should wash only her hands."
arabicText: وَ رَوَى اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ قَالَ: مَضَى صَاحِبٌ لَنَا يَسْأَلُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ مَعَ رِجَالٍ لَيْسَ فِيهِمْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ هَلْ يُغَسِّلُونَهَا وَ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا فَقَالَ« إِذَنْ يُدْخَلَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَكِنْ يَغْسِلُونَ كَفَّيْهَا».
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from Dawud ibn Farqad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: A companion of ours went to ask Abu ‘Abdillah (a.s), about a woman who dies among men, none of whom are her mahram (close male relatives). He asked whether they are permitted to wash her while she is in her clothes. Abu ‘Abdillah (a.s), replied: "If they were to do that, it would be exposing her (to improper handling). Instead, they should wash only her hands."
